def draw_menu_background():

    if bg_image:

        screen.blit(bg_image, (0, 0))

    else:

        screen.fill(C_BLACK)

def draw_menu():

    # ── Compute dt and advance all polish animation systems ──
    # Per PYGAME_MASTER_ENGINEER Module 4: dt-based motion so the feel is
    # identical at 60Hz, 144Hz, or under frame drops.
    now_ms = pygame.time.get_ticks()
    if not _anim.initialized:
        _init_menu_anim()
        _anim.last_ms = now_ms
    dt = (now_ms - _anim.last_ms) / 1000.0
    _anim.last_ms = now_ms
    # Clamp dt to a max of 1/15s so a long frame stall (window drag, etc.)
    # doesn't catapult rain drops across the screen.
    dt = min(dt, 1.0 / 15.0)
    _update_menu_anim(dt)

    # ── Detect mouse motion → release keyboard focus ──
    # If the mouse actually moved since last frame, hand control back to the
    # mouse. pygame.mouse.get_rel() returns the delta since the last call.
    mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_rel()
    if mx != 0 or my != 0:
        reset_keyboard_selection()

    # ── Background + rain + embers (under the dark panel) ──
    draw_menu_background()
    _draw_rain(screen)
    _draw_embers(screen)

    # Dark panel overlay (existing CRT-style left panel)
    screen.blit(_menu_overlay, (0, 0))

    # ── Top classification banner OR boot sequence ──
    # On first menu show, the boot banner plays a typewriter sequence.
    # Once done, the normal "// KRAPNET TERMINAL //" banner takes over.
    if not _draw_boot_banner(screen):
        classif_bar = pygame.Surface((460, 22), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        classif_bar.fill((8, 10, 14, 220))
        pygame.draw.line(classif_bar, C_ORANGE, (0, 0), (460, 0), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(classif_bar, C_ORANGE, (0, 21), (460, 21), 1)
        screen.blit(classif_bar, (20, 20))
        classif_text = _classification_font.render(
            "// KRAPNET TERMINAL — CLEARANCE: OPERATOR //", True, C_ORANGE
        )
        screen.blit(classif_text, (30, 24))

    # ── Title (no glow — kept clean per user preference) ──
    title_x = 40
    title_y = 110
    title_text = "CALL OF ACARISTAN"

    # Measure title for scanline math.
    title_surf = font_title.render(title_text, True, C_WHITE)
    title_w = title_surf.get_width()
    title_h = title_surf.get_height()

    # Drop shadow
    screen.blit(font_title.render(title_text, True, (0, 0, 0)),
                (title_x + 4, title_y + 4))
    # Main title
    screen.blit(title_surf, (title_x, title_y))

    # Scanline drift over the title text (drawn after, additive).
    _draw_scanline_drift(screen, title_x, title_y, title_w, title_h)

    # Orange accent bar under title
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, C_ORANGE, (title_x, title_y + 88, 320, 3))

    # ── Section header above menu buttons ──
    pygame.draw.line(screen, (60, 45, 25), (135, 320), (420, 320), 1)
    section_lbl = _classification_font.render("MAIN TERMINAL", True, (140, 100, 50))
    screen.blit(section_lbl, (135, 305))

    # ── Active save slot summary ──
    slot = save_system.get_slot()
    slot_idx = save_system.current_slot_index() + 1
    slot_panel = pygame.Surface((350, 48), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    slot_panel.fill((0, 0, 0, 135))
    pygame.draw.rect(slot_panel, (45, 70, 90, 120), slot_panel.get_rect(), 1)
    pygame.draw.line(slot_panel, C_KRAP_BLUE, (0, 0), (0, 48), 3)
    screen.blit(slot_panel, (135, 260))

    active = _footer_font.render(f"ACTIVE SAVE SLOT: {slot_idx}", True, (80, 150, 190))
    last = slot.get("last_completed_label", "No missions completed")
    if slot.get("last_completed_mission"):
        last = "LAST COMPLETED: " + last
    elif slot.get("occupied"):
        last = slot.get("last_completed_label", "Campaign started")
    else:
        last = "EMPTY SLOT — START A NEW CAMPAIGN"
    last_surf = _footer_font.render(last[:48], True, (145, 145, 135))
    screen.blit(active, (150, 268))
    screen.blit(last_surf, (150, 286))

    # ── Buttons ──
    has_save = save_system.has_any_save()
    if has_save:
        layout = [
            (0, 330, "CONTINUE"),
            (1, 390, "NEW CAMPAIGN"),
            (2, 450, "MULTIPLAYER"),
            (3, 510, "SETTINGS"),
            (4, 570, "EXIT"),
        ]
    else:
        # No Continue button until at least one save slot exists.
        layout = [
            (0, -999, "CONTINUE"),
            (1, 350, "NEW CAMPAIGN"),
            (2, 410, "MULTIPLAYER"),
            (3, 470, "SETTINGS"),
            (4, 530, "EXIT"),
        ]

    for idx, y, text in layout:
        buttons[idx].text = text
        buttons[idx].y = y
        buttons[idx].rect.y = y

    for i, btn in enumerate(buttons):
        if btn.y < 0:
            btn.is_hovered = False
            btn.is_selected = False
            btn.update(dt)
            continue
        btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())
        # Apply keyboard focus: a button is selected if its index matches
        # the keyboard cursor AND the mouse isn't currently hovering it.
        btn.is_selected = (_anim.keyboard_idx == i) and not btn.is_hovered
        btn.update(dt)
        btn.draw(screen)

    # ── News ticker (above footer) ──
    _draw_news_ticker(screen)

    # ── Bottom divider line above footer ──
    pygame.draw.line(screen, (40, 30, 15), (30, HEIGHT - 50), (470, HEIGHT - 50), 1)

    # ── Footer ──
    footer_left = _footer_font.render(
        "v0.1.0  ·  BUILD 4471", True, (90, 90, 95)
    )
    screen.blit(footer_left, (30, HEIGHT - 38))

    footer_right = _footer_font.render(
        "© RETARDOVICI INC.", True, (90, 90, 95)
    )
    screen.blit(footer_right, (470 - footer_right.get_width(), HEIGHT - 38))

    # Blinking status indicator
    if (pygame.time.get_ticks() // 600) % 2 == 0:
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (50, 220, 100), (40, HEIGHT - 22), 3)
    else:
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (30, 130, 60), (40, HEIGHT - 22), 3)

    status_text = _footer_font.render("CONNECTED — KRAPNET RELAY 7", True, (60, 70, 65))
    screen.blit(status_text, (50, HEIGHT - 26))

    # ── Vignette (drawn last so it darkens the edges over everything) ──
    _draw_vignette(screen)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MENU POLISH SYSTEMS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Applied per PYGAME_MASTER_ENGINEER Module 2 + Module 4:
#   - dt-based lerp for all motion (frame-rate independent)
#   - separate update() and draw() passes (MVC)
#   - pre-rendered surfaces for static art (vignette, glow sprites)
#
# Systems:
#   _lerp_dt          — frame-rate-independent lerp helper
#   _anim             — module-level state for all polish systems
#   _init_menu_anim   — populate rain drops + embers (idempotent)
#   _update_menu_anim — step all animations forward by dt seconds
#   _draw_rain        — 3-layer parallax rain + ground splashes
#   _draw_embers      — drifting fire embers from right-side glow
#   _draw_vignette    — radial dark edge overlay
#   _draw_title_glow  — pulsing orange halo behind the title
#   _draw_scanline_drift — moving horizontal scanline over the title
#   _draw_boot_banner — typewriter KRAPNET boot text on first menu show
#   _draw_news_ticker — scrolling lore ticker above the footer
#
# Keyboard navigation (Module 2 accessibility):
#   keyboard_idx                  — currently focused button index, -1 = mouse
#   handle_menu_keydown(event)    — call from acaristan MENU-state KEYDOWN
#   consume_keyboard_trigger()    — returns button index to fire, or -1
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


def _lerp_dt(current, target, speed_per_sec, dt):
    """Frame-rate-independent exponential lerp.

    `speed_per_sec` is the approximate "fraction of remaining distance closed
    per second". At 60fps with speed=12, this behaves like the old `* 0.2`
    per-frame lerp but stays correct at any frame rate.
    """
    if dt <= 0:
        return current
    # Equivalent to applying `* k` per-frame where k = 1 - exp(-speed * dt).
    k = 1.0 - math.exp(-speed_per_sec * dt)
    return current + (target - current) * k


# ── Module-level animation state ─────────────────────────────────────────
# All long-lived state for the polish systems lives here, initialized lazily
# on first draw_menu() call so we don't pay for it during gameplay.

class _MenuAnimState:
    """Holds all per-frame animation state for the menu polish systems.

    Kept as a plain class (not a dict) so attribute typos raise immediately.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.initialized = False
        self.last_ms = 0           # last pygame.time.get_ticks() value
        self.t = 0.0               # total elapsed time (seconds) since first draw
        self.rain_drops = []       # list of dicts: x, y, length, speed, layer, alpha
        self.splashes = []         # list of dicts: x, y, age, max_age, radius
        self.embers = []           # list of dicts: x, y, vx, vy, age, max_age, brightness
        self.vignette = None       # pre-rendered radial dark edge surface
        self.title_glow_pulse = 0.0  # 0..1, oscillates with sin(t * 1.8)
        self.boot_done = False
        self.boot_t = 0.0          # seconds since first menu draw
        self.boot_chars_typed = 0  # typewriter cursor for boot banner
        self.ticker_offset = 0.0   # pixels scrolled
        # Keyboard nav
        self.keyboard_idx = -1     # -1 = mouse control, 0..N-1 = focused button
        self.pending_trigger = -1  # button index that should fire this frame, or -1


_anim = _MenuAnimState()

    "BIRIBEL TASKING ORDERS UPDATED — RELAY 7",
    "FUEGOTECH K1 LAUNCH PARTY INVITES LEAKED ONLINE",
    "WEATHER: HEAVY RAIN, VISIBILITY LOW — ALL ROUTES",
    "KRAP PUBLIC AFFAIRS: 'WE HAVE THE SITUATION IN HAND'",
]
_TICKER_SPEED = 60.0  # pixels per second


def _init_menu_anim():
    """Populate rain drops, embers, and pre-rendered surfaces.

    Idempotent — safe to call multiple times, only the first call does work.
    """
    if _anim.initialized:
        return
    _anim.initialized = True
    _anim.last_ms = pygame.time.get_ticks()

    # ---- Rain: 3 layers, very subtle ----
    # Tuned WAY down per user feedback ("pretty eh"). Now reads as a faint
    # atmospheric hint rather than a full storm — short streaks, dim alpha,
    # only 40 drops total across all three layers.
    layer_specs = [
        # (count, length_range, speed_range, alpha_range, thickness)
        (18, (6, 10),  (160, 240), (35, 60),   1),   # far — barely visible
        (15, (10, 16), (280, 380), (60, 90),   1),   # mid
        (7,  (16, 22), (440, 560), (90, 130),  1),   # near — slightly brighter
    ]
    for count, lr, sr, ar, thick in layer_specs:
        for _ in range(count):
            _anim.rain_drops.append({
                "x": random.uniform(0, WIDTH + 80),
                "y": random.uniform(0, HEIGHT),
                "length": random.uniform(*lr),
                "speed": random.uniform(*sr),
                "alpha": random.randint(*ar),
                "thickness": thick,
                # All drops share the same wind angle for visual coherence.
                "wind": -0.18,  # radians from vertical, blows slightly left
            })

    # ---- Vignette: pre-rendered radial gradient ----
    # Transparent in the center, dark at the edges. Built once and reused.
    vig = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    cx, cy = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2
    max_r = math.hypot(cx, cy)
    # Render as concentric rings from outside in — cheaper per-ring than
    # per-pixel, and the gradient is smooth enough at this resolution.
    for r in range(int(max_r), 0, -2):
        # 0 at center, 1 at edge.
        t = r / max_r
        # Ease so the darkening is concentrated near the edges.
        eased = t ** 2.2
        alpha = int(180 * eased)
        if alpha < 2:
            continue
        pygame.draw.circle(vig, (0, 0, 0, alpha), (cx, cy), r)
    _anim.vignette = vig


def _update_menu_anim(dt):
    """Advance all animation systems by dt seconds."""
    if not _anim.initialized:
        _init_menu_anim()

    _anim.t += dt
    _anim.title_glow_pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(_anim.t * 1.8)

    # ---- Rain drops ----
    ground_y = int(HEIGHT * 0.88)
    for d in _anim.rain_drops:
        # Velocity vector: mostly downward, slight wind slant.
        vx = math.sin(d["wind"]) * d["speed"]
        vy = math.cos(d["wind"]) * d["speed"]
        d["x"] += vx * dt
        d["y"] += vy * dt
        # Wrap when off-screen.
        if d["y"] > ground_y:
            # Spawn a splash ripple on impact (rare, only mid/near layers
            # — kept sparse per "rain is pretty eh" feedback).
            if d["thickness"] >= 1 and random.random() < 0.12:
                _anim.splashes.append({
                    "x": d["x"],
                    "y": ground_y + random.uniform(0, 6),
                    "age": 0.0,
                    "max_age": random.uniform(0.35, 0.55),
                    "radius": random.uniform(3, 6),
                })
            d["y"] = random.uniform(-40, 0)
            d["x"] = random.uniform(-40, WIDTH + 80)
        elif d["x"] < -50:
            d["x"] = WIDTH + 40

    # ---- Splashes ----
    # Cheap pooled list — remove in place by swapping with the last element.
    i = 0
    while i < len(_anim.splashes):
        s = _anim.splashes[i]
        s["age"] += dt
        if s["age"] >= s["max_age"]:
            _anim.splashes[i] = _anim.splashes[-1]
            _anim.splashes.pop()
        else:
            i += 1

    # ---- Embers ----
    # Spawn new embers from the right edge (where the bg fire glow lives).
    # Rate scales with dt so spawn density is frame-rate independent.
    spawn_chance = 60.0 * dt  # avg 60 per second
    while spawn_chance > 0:
        if random.random() < min(1.0, spawn_chance):
            _anim.embers.append({
                "x": random.uniform(WIDTH - 80, WIDTH + 10),
                "y": random.uniform(HEIGHT * 0.45, HEIGHT * 0.85),
                "vx": random.uniform(-1.5, -0.4),
                "vy": random.uniform(-1.2, -0.2),
                "age": 0.0,
                "max_age": random.uniform(2.0, 4.0),
                "brightness": random.uniform(0.6, 1.0),
                "size": random.randint(1, 2),
            })
        spawn_chance -= 1.0

    i = 0
    while i < len(_anim.embers):
        e = _anim.embers[i]
        e["age"] += dt
        e["x"] += e["vx"]
        e["y"] += e["vy"]
        # Slight upward acceleration as the ember heats.
        e["vy"] -= 0.02 * dt * 60
        if e["age"] >= e["max_age"] or e["x"] < -10 or e["y"] < -10:
            _anim.embers[i] = _anim.embers[-1]
            _anim.embers.pop()
        else:
            i += 1

    # ---- Boot sequence ----
    if not _anim.boot_done:
        _anim.boot_t += dt
        # Total chars across all lines + delays between lines.
        total_chars = sum(len(line) for line in _BOOT_LINES)
        total_delays = _BOOT_LINE_DELAY * len(_BOOT_LINES)
        total_duration = total_chars / _BOOT_CHAR_RATE + total_delays
        _anim.boot_chars_typed = int(
            max(0.0, _anim.boot_t) * _BOOT_CHAR_RATE
        )
        if _anim.boot_t >= total_duration + 0.4:
            _anim.boot_done = True

    # ---- News ticker ----
    _anim.ticker_offset += _TICKER_SPEED * dt
    # Wrap when we've scrolled one full loop width.
    # Computed lazily in _draw_news_ticker; just keep the offset bounded.
    if _anim.ticker_offset > 10_000:
        _anim.ticker_offset -= 10_000


# ── Draw helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def _draw_rain(surface):
    """3-layer parallax rain + ground splashes."""
    if not _anim.initialized:
        return
    # Single scratch surface for all drops — drawn once per frame, cheaper
    # than per-drop SRCALPHA surfaces.
    rain_surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for d in _anim.rain_drops:
        vx = math.sin(d["wind"])
        vy = math.cos(d["wind"])
        x2 = d["x"] + vx * d["length"]
        y2 = d["y"] + vy * d["length"]
        col = (180, 200, 220, d["alpha"])
        if d["thickness"] == 1:
            pygame.draw.line(rain_surf, col,
                             (int(d["x"]), int(d["y"])),
                             (int(x2), int(y2)), 1)
        else:
            pygame.draw.line(rain_surf, col,
                             (int(d["x"]), int(d["y"])),
                             (int(x2), int(y2)), 2)
    surface.blit(rain_surf, (0, 0))

    # Splashes on top of rain.
    if _anim.splashes:
        splash_surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for s in _anim.splashes:
            t = s["age"] / s["max_age"]
            r = int(s["radius"] * (1 + t * 3))
            a = int(180 * (1 - t))
            if a <= 0 or r <= 0:
                continue
            pygame.draw.ellipse(
                splash_surf, (180, 200, 220, a),
                (int(s["x"] - r), int(s["y"] - r // 2), r * 2, r),
                1,
            )
        surface.blit(splash_surf, (0, 0))


def _draw_embers(surface):
    """Drifting fire embers from the right-side bg glow."""
    if not _anim.initialized or not _anim.embers:
        return
    em_surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for e in _anim.embers:
        t = e["age"] / e["max_age"]
        # Brightness fades in then out.
        fade = math.sin(t * math.pi) * e["brightness"]
        if fade <= 0:
            continue
        # Color: bright yellow at birth → orange mid → red at death.
        if t < 0.4:
            col = (255, int(180 + 60 * (1 - t / 0.4)), 80, int(220 * fade))
        elif t < 0.75:
            col = (255, 130, 40, int(220 * fade))
        else:
            col = (220, 80, 30, int(180 * fade))
        r = e["size"]
        pygame.draw.circle(em_surf, col, (int(e["x"]), int(e["y"])), r)
        # Soft halo around bright embers.
        if fade > 0.5:
            halo_a = int(60 * fade)
            pygame.draw.circle(
                em_surf, (255, 140, 60, halo_a),
                (int(e["x"]), int(e["y"])), r * 2, 1
            )
    surface.blit(em_surf, (0, 0))


def _draw_vignette(surface):
    """Pre-rendered radial dark edge overlay."""
    if _anim.vignette is not None:
        surface.blit(_anim.vignette, (0, 0))


def _draw_title_glow(surface, title_x, title_y, title_w, title_h):
    """Slow orange glow pulse behind the title."""
    if not _anim.initialized:
        return
    # Glow size covers the title plus a 40px margin.
    glow_w = title_w + 80
    glow_h = title_h + 60
    glow = pygame.Surface((glow_w, glow_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    cx, cy = glow_w // 2, glow_h // 2
    max_r = math.hypot(cx, cy)
    pulse = _anim.title_glow_pulse
    # Layered concentric ellipses, each softer than the last.
    for r in range(int(max_r), 4, -8):
        t = r / max_r
        eased = (1 - t) ** 2
        alpha = int(45 * eased * pulse)
        if alpha < 2:
            continue
        pygame.draw.ellipse(
            glow, (255, 120, 0, alpha),
            (cx - r, cy - int(r * 0.55), r * 2, int(r * 1.1))
        )
    surface.blit(
        glow,
        (title_x + title_w // 2 - glow_w // 2,
         title_y + title_h // 2 - glow_h // 2),
        special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD,
    )


def _draw_scanline_drift(surface, x, y, w, h):
    """A bright horizontal scanline that slowly drifts across the title."""
    if not _anim.initialized:
        return
    # Drift period: 5 seconds top-to-bottom.
    period = 5.0
    t = (_anim.t % period) / period
    line_y = y + int(t * h)
    # Bright line + soft glow above/below.
    line_surf = pygame.Surface((w, 12), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(12):
        a = int(80 * (1 - abs(i - 6) / 6))
        if a > 0:
            pygame.draw.line(line_surf, (255, 200, 140, a),
                             (0, i), (w, i), 1)
    surface.blit(line_surf, (x, line_y - 6),
                 special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)


def _draw_boot_banner(surface):
    """Typewriter KRAPNET boot sequence shown on first menu show.

    Returns True while the boot is still playing (so draw_menu can suppress
    the normal classification banner), False when done.
    """
    if _anim.boot_done:
        return False

    # Backdrop — same dimensions as the normal classification banner.
    banner = pygame.Surface((460, 22), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    banner.fill((8, 10, 14, 230))
    pygame.draw.line(banner, C_ORANGE, (0, 0), (460, 0), 1)
    pygame.draw.line(banner, C_ORANGE, (0, 21), (460, 21), 1)
    surface.blit(banner, (20, 20))

    # Render lines with a typewriter effect, staggered by _BOOT_LINE_DELAY.
    chars_remaining = _anim.boot_chars_typed
    y_offset = 24
    for line_idx, line in enumerate(_BOOT_LINES):
        # Each line starts typing at line_idx * _BOOT_LINE_DELAY worth of
        # chars consumed.
        start_chars = int(line_idx * _BOOT_LINE_DELAY * _BOOT_CHAR_RATE)
        if chars_remaining <= start_chars:
            break
        chars_on_this_line = min(
            len(line), chars_remaining - start_chars
        )
        visible = line[:chars_on_this_line]
        # Blinking cursor on the line currently being typed.
        if chars_on_this_line < len(line) and \
           (line_idx == len(_BOOT_LINES) - 1 or
            chars_remaining < start_chars + len(line)):
            if int(_anim.t * 3) % 2 == 0:
                visible += "_"
        surf = _classification_font.render(visible, True, C_ORANGE)
        surface.blit(surf, (30, y_offset))
        y_offset += 14
        if y_offset > 64:  # clamp to banner area
            break

    return True


def _draw_news_ticker(surface):
    """Scrolling lore ticker above the footer."""
    # Compose the full ticker string with separators.
    separator = "  ◆  "
    full = separator.join(_TICKER_ITEMS) + separator
    full_surf = _footer_font.render(full, True, (180, 160, 110))
    sep_surf = _footer_font.render(separator, True, C_ORANGE)
    sep_w = sep_surf.get_width()
    full_w = full_surf.get_width()

    # Ticker area: above the footer divider line, full width of the dark panel.
    ticker_y = HEIGHT - 56
    ticker_h = 18
    # Backdrop strip.
    strip = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, ticker_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    strip.fill((0, 0, 0, 150))
    surface.blit(strip, (0, ticker_y))

    # KRAPNET WIRE label on the left — static.
    label = _classification_font.render("KRAPNET WIRE", True, C_ORANGE)
    label_w = label.get_width() + 16
    surface.blit(label, (8, ticker_y + 2))
    # Vertical separator after the label.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (90, 60, 25),
                     (label_w, ticker_y),
                     (label_w, ticker_y + ticker_h), 1)

    # Scrolling text window: from label_w to WIDTH.
    window_w = WIDTH - label_w - 4
    if window_w <= 0 or full_w <= 0:
        return

    # Offset wraps modulo (full_w + sep_w) so the loop is seamless.
    period = full_w + sep_w
    offset = int(_anim.ticker_offset) % period

    # Draw the text twice — once at -offset, once at (period - offset) — so
    # the loop has no visible gap when it wraps.
    clip_rect = pygame.Rect(label_w + 2, ticker_y, window_w, ticker_h)
    prev_clip = surface.get_clip()
    surface.set_clip(clip_rect)
    surface.blit(full_surf, (label_w + 4 - offset, ticker_y + 2))
    surface.blit(full_surf, (label_w + 4 - offset + period, ticker_y + 2))
    surface.set_clip(prev_clip)

    # Top border line on the ticker strip.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (60, 40, 15),
                     (0, ticker_y), (WIDTH, ticker_y), 1)


# ── Keyboard navigation API ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Public functions called by acaristan.py. Designed so the existing mouse
# click path keeps working unchanged — keyboard input is layered on top.


def _visible_button_indices():
    """Return list of indices into `buttons[]` that are currently on-screen.

    draw_menu() sets each button's `y` to -999 when it should be hidden
    (e.g. CONTINUE when no save exists). We respect that convention here.
    """
    return [i for i, b in enumerate(buttons) if b.y > 0]


def handle_menu_keydown(event):
    """Process a KEYDOWN event in the MENU state.

    Call from acaristan.py's event loop when game_state == "MENU".
    Returns None — side effects are stored in _anim.pending_trigger, which
    acaristan.py reads via consume_keyboard_trigger().
    """
    if not _anim.initialized:
        _init_menu_anim()

    if event.key in (pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
        visible = _visible_button_indices()
        if not visible:
            return
        if _anim.keyboard_idx == -1:
            # Initializing from mouse control — pick the bottom visible.
            _anim.keyboard_idx = visible[-1]
        elif _anim.keyboard_idx in visible:
            i = visible.index(_anim.keyboard_idx)
            _anim.keyboard_idx = visible[(i - 1) % len(visible)]
        else:
            _anim.keyboard_idx = visible[-1]
        audio.play("menu_hover", volume=0.3)
    elif event.key in (pygame.K_DOWN, pygame.K_s):
        visible = _visible_button_indices()
        if not visible:
            return
        if _anim.keyboard_idx == -1:
            _anim.keyboard_idx = visible[0]
        elif _anim.keyboard_idx in visible:
            i = visible.index(_anim.keyboard_idx)
            _anim.keyboard_idx = visible[(i + 1) % len(visible)]
        else:
            _anim.keyboard_idx = visible[0]
        audio.play("menu_hover", volume=0.3)
    elif event.key in (pygame.K_RETURN, pygame.K_SPACE):
        if _anim.keyboard_idx != -1:
            _anim.pending_trigger = _anim.keyboard_idx
            buttons[_anim.keyboard_idx].press()
            audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.5)


def consume_keyboard_trigger():
    """Return the button index that should fire this frame, or -1.

    acaristan.py should call this after draw_menu() and route the trigger
    through the same action handlers as a mouse click.
    """
    t = _anim.pending_trigger
    _anim.pending_trigger = -1
    return t


def reset_keyboard_selection():
    """Clear keyboard focus — called when the mouse moves."""
    _anim.keyboard_idx = -1

def _server_status(cur, max_p, ping):

    if cur >= max_p:

        return "FULL", (220, 120, 45)

    if ping >= 180:

        return "UNSTABLE", (220, 80, 70)

    return "OPEN", C_TERMINAL

def _draw_server_badge(text, color, x, y, w=78):

    badge = pygame.Surface((w, 22), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    badge.fill((8, 12, 16, 210))

    pygame.draw.rect(badge, color, badge.get_rect(), 1)

    screen.blit(badge, (x, y))

    label = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, color)

    screen.blit(label, (x + w // 2 - label.get_width() // 2, y + 4))

def _fit_text(text, font, max_width):

    if font.size(text)[0] <= max_width:

        return text

    ellipsis = "..."

    while text and font.size(text + ellipsis)[0] > max_width:

        text = text[:-1]

    return text + ellipsis

def update_server_browser_animation():

    """Called once per frame while on multiplayer screen."""

    global _server_animation_timer, _chat_next_spawn, _chat_messages

    global _refresh_active, _refresh_progress

    _server_animation_timer += 1

    # Animate pings + player counts every ~90 frames (1.5s)

    if _server_animation_timer % 90 == 0 and not _refresh_active:

        for i, (name, cur, max_p, ping) in enumerate(server_list):

            delta = random.choice([-1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1])

            new_cur = max(0, min(max_p, cur + delta))

            new_ping = max(8, min(400, ping + random.randint(-6, 6)))

            server_list[i] = (name, new_cur, max_p, new_ping)

    # Refresh progress

    if _refresh_active:

        _refresh_progress += 0.025

        if _refresh_progress >= 1.0:

            _refresh_active = False

            _refresh_progress = 0.0

            for i, (name, cur, max_p, ping) in enumerate(server_list):

                new_cur = max(0, min(max_p, cur + random.randint(-3, 3)))

                new_ping = max(8, min(400, ping + random.randint(-25, 25)))

                server_list[i] = (name, new_cur, max_p, new_ping)

    # Spawn chat messages

    _chat_next_spawn -= 1

    if _chat_next_spawn <= 0:

        msg = random.choice(CHAT_POOL)

        _chat_messages.append({

            "user": msg[0],

            "text": msg[1],

            "color": msg[2],

            "age": 0,

        })

        _chat_next_spawn = random.randint(60, 130)

        if random.random() < 0.18:

            msg2 = random.choice(CHAT_POOL)

            _chat_messages.append({

                "user": msg2[0],

                "text": msg2[1],

                "color": msg2[2],

                "age": 0,

            })

        if len(_chat_messages) > 50:

            _chat_messages.pop(0)

    # Age messages

    for m in _chat_messages:

        m["age"] += 1

def switch_mp_tab(tab):

    global _mp_tab

    _mp_tab = tab

    audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.3)

def open_dm(user_idx):

    global _dm_open_user, _dm_input

    _dm_open_user = user_idx

    _dm_input = ""

    if user_idx not in _dm_history:

        _dm_history[user_idx] = []

    audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.3)

def close_dm():

    global _dm_open_user, _dm_input

    _dm_open_user = None

    _dm_input = ""

def send_dm_message():

    global _dm_input, _dm_response_delay, _dm_pending_reply

    if _dm_open_user is None or not _dm_input.strip():

        return

    _dm_history[_dm_open_user].append({

        "from": "you",

        "text": _dm_input.strip(),

        "age": 0,

    })

    _dm_input = ""

    _dm_response_delay = random.randint(45, 110)

    _dm_pending_reply = _dm_open_user

    audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.2)

def update_dm_state():

    global _dm_response_delay, _dm_pending_reply

    if _dm_open_user is not None and _dm_open_user in _dm_history:

        for m in _dm_history[_dm_open_user]:

            m["age"] += 1

    if _dm_response_delay > 0:

        _dm_response_delay -= 1

        if _dm_response_delay == 0 and _dm_pending_reply is not None:

            reply = random.choice(CONNECTIONS[_dm_pending_reply]["replies"])

            _dm_history[_dm_pending_reply].append({

                "from": "them",

                "text": reply,

                "age": 0,

            })

            _dm_pending_reply = None

            audio.play("menu_hover", volume=0.3)

def _status_color(status):

    if "Online" in status or status == "always":

        return (80, 220, 100)

    if "Away" in status or "Meeting" in status:

        return (220, 180, 60)

    if "Game" in status:

        return (100, 160, 220)

    if "Offline" in status or "Deleted" in status or "never" in status:

        return (110, 110, 110)

    if "\u2588" in status:

        return (140, 60, 60)

    return (180, 180, 180)

def draw_connections_panel():

    """Draws the friends list + active DM window."""

    mouse_pos = get_scaled_mouse()

    list_x = SERVER_PANEL_X + 28

    list_y = SERVER_LIST_TOP - 4

    list_w = 340

    row_h = 38

    list_header = font_terminal_small.render("CONTACTS", True, (80, 130, 160))

    screen.blit(list_header, (list_x + 6, list_y - 20))

    online_count = sum(1 for c in CONNECTIONS if "Online" in c["status"])

    online_lbl = font_terminal_small.render(

        f"{online_count} ONLINE  \u00b7  {len(CONNECTIONS)} TOTAL",

        True, (90, 130, 100),

    )

    screen.blit(online_lbl, (list_x + list_w - online_lbl.get_width() - 6, list_y - 20))

    list_bottom_limit = SERVER_PANEL_Y + SERVER_PANEL_H - 90

    visible_friends = (list_bottom_limit - list_y) // row_h

    visible_friends = min(visible_friends, len(CONNECTIONS))

    for vi in range(visible_friends):

        i = vi + _dm_scroll_offset

        if i >= len(CONNECTIONS):

            break

        conn = CONNECTIONS[i]

        ry = list_y + vi * row_h

        row_rect = pygame.Rect(list_x, ry, list_w, row_h - 4)

        hover = row_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)

        is_open = _dm_open_user == i

        row_surf = pygame.Surface((list_w, row_h - 4), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        if is_open:

            row_surf.fill((28, 36, 42, 235))

            pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, C_ORANGE, row_surf.get_rect(), 1)

            pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, (255, 120, 0, 130), (0, 0, 3, row_h - 4))

        elif hover:

            row_surf.fill((18, 28, 34, 225))

            pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, (80, 120, 140), row_surf.get_rect(), 1)

        else:

            row_surf.fill((9, 14, 18, 210))

            pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, (28, 44, 56), row_surf.get_rect(), 1)

        screen.blit(row_surf, row_rect)

        s_col = _status_color(conn["status"])

        pygame.draw.circle(screen, s_col, (list_x + 14, ry + 17), 4)

        name_col = C_WHITE if (hover or is_open) else conn["color"]

        name_surf = font_terminal.render(conn["name"], True, name_col)

        screen.blit(name_surf, (list_x + 28, ry + 4))

        status_text = f"{conn['status']}  \u00b7  {conn['last_seen']}"

        if len(status_text) > 38:

            status_text = status_text[:35] + "..."

        st_surf = font_terminal_small.render(status_text, True, (120, 130, 140))

        screen.blit(st_surf, (list_x + 28, ry + 22))

    # ── Scroll indicators ──

    remaining_below = len(CONNECTIONS) - (_dm_scroll_offset + visible_friends)

    remaining_above = _dm_scroll_offset

    more_y = list_y + visible_friends * row_h + 4

    if remaining_below > 0 and remaining_above > 0:

        more_lbl = font_terminal_small.render(

            f"\u25b2 {remaining_above} above  \u00b7  \u25bc {remaining_below} below  \u00b7  scroll wheel",

            True, (90, 110, 130),

        )

        screen.blit(more_lbl, (list_x + 6, more_y))

    elif remaining_below > 0:

        more_lbl = font_terminal_small.render(

            f"\u25bc {remaining_below} more contacts  \u00b7  scroll wheel",

            True, (90, 110, 130),

        )

        screen.blit(more_lbl, (list_x + 6, more_y))

    elif remaining_above > 0:

        more_lbl = font_terminal_small.render(

            f"\u25b2 {remaining_above} above  \u00b7  scroll wheel",

            True, (90, 110, 130),

        )

        screen.blit(more_lbl, (list_x + 6, more_y))

    # ── Scrollbar for contacts ──

    if len(CONNECTIONS) > visible_friends:

        sb_x = list_x + list_w + 4

        sb_y = list_y

        sb_h = visible_friends * row_h - 4

        sb_w = 5

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 22, 28), (sb_x, sb_y, sb_w, sb_h))

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (28, 44, 56), (sb_x, sb_y, sb_w, sb_h), 1)

        thumb_ratio = visible_friends / len(CONNECTIONS)

        thumb_h = max(20, int(sb_h * thumb_ratio))

        max_scroll = max(1, len(CONNECTIONS) - visible_friends)

        thumb_y = sb_y + int((sb_h - thumb_h) * (_dm_scroll_offset / max_scroll))

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, C_ORANGE, (sb_x, thumb_y, sb_w, thumb_h))

    # DM window (right column)

    dm_x = list_x + list_w + 16

    dm_y = list_y - 4

    dm_w = SERVER_PANEL_X + SERVER_PANEL_W - dm_x - 28

    dm_h = SERVER_PANEL_H - 220

    dm_bg = pygame.Surface((dm_w, dm_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    dm_bg.fill((6, 11, 16, 230))

    pygame.draw.rect(dm_bg, (30, 50, 60), dm_bg.get_rect(), 1)

    pygame.draw.rect(dm_bg, (40, 60, 70, 100), dm_bg.get_rect(), 1)

    screen.blit(dm_bg, (dm_x, dm_y))

    if _dm_open_user is None:

        empty_lbl = font_terminal.render("// SELECT A CONTACT //", True, (60, 90, 110))

        screen.blit(

            empty_lbl,

            (dm_x + dm_w // 2 - empty_lbl.get_width() // 2,

             dm_y + dm_h // 2 - 20),

        )

        hint = font_terminal_small.render(

            "Click a name on the left to start a conversation",

            True, (50, 70, 85),

        )

        screen.blit(

            hint,

            (dm_x + dm_w // 2 - hint.get_width() // 2,

             dm_y + dm_h // 2 + 8),

        )

    else:

        conn = CONNECTIONS[_dm_open_user]

        s_col = _status_color(conn["status"])

        pygame.draw.circle(screen, s_col, (dm_x + 14, dm_y + 14), 4)

        hdr = font_terminal.render(conn["name"], True, conn["color"])

        screen.blit(hdr, (dm_x + 26, dm_y + 4))

        st = font_terminal_small.render(

            conn["status"], True, _status_color(conn["status"]),

        )

        screen.blit(st, (dm_x + 26, dm_y + 22))

        pygame.draw.line(

            screen, (30, 50, 60),

            (dm_x + 8, dm_y + 40),

            (dm_x + dm_w - 8, dm_y + 40), 1,

        )

        msg_x = dm_x + 12

        msg_y = dm_y + 48

        msg_w = dm_w - 24

        msg_area_h = dm_h - 100

        history = _dm_history.get(_dm_open_user, [])

        rendered = []

        for m in history:

            text = m["text"]

            is_you = m["from"] == "you"

            col = (220, 220, 220) if is_you else conn["color"]

            words = text.split(" ")

            line = ""

            wrapped = []

            for w in words:

                test = (line + " " + w).strip() if line else w

                if font_terminal_small.size(test)[0] <= msg_w - 60:

                    line = test

                else:

                    if line:

                        wrapped.append(line)

                    line = w

            if line:

                wrapped.append(line)

            for li, ln in enumerate(wrapped):

                prefix = ""

                if li == 0:

                    prefix = "you: " if is_you else f"{conn['name']}: "

                rendered.append((prefix, ln, col, is_you, m["age"]))

        line_h = 16

        max_lines = msg_area_h // line_h

        visible = rendered[-max_lines:]

        for li, (prefix, ln, col, is_you, age) in enumerate(visible):

            ly = msg_y + li * line_h

            alpha = min(255, age * 15)

            if prefix:

                p_col = (140, 140, 145) if is_you else col

                ps = font_terminal_small.render(prefix, True, p_col)

                ps.set_alpha(alpha)

                screen.blit(ps, (msg_x, ly))

                ts = font_terminal_small.render(ln, True, (220, 220, 220) if is_you else (210, 210, 215))

                ts.set_alpha(alpha)

                screen.blit(ts, (msg_x + ps.get_width(), ly))

            else:

                ts = font_terminal_small.render("  " + ln, True, (210, 210, 215))

                ts.set_alpha(alpha)

                screen.blit(ts, (msg_x, ly))

        if _dm_response_delay > 0 and _dm_pending_reply == _dm_open_user:

            dots = "." * (((pygame.time.get_ticks() // 300) % 3) + 1)

            typing = font_terminal_small.render(

                f"{conn['name']} is typing{dots}", True, (100, 130, 150),

            )

            screen.blit(typing, (msg_x, dm_y + dm_h - 64))

        input_box_y = dm_y + dm_h - 42

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 22, 28), (dm_x + 8, input_box_y, dm_w - 16, 32))

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (50, 80, 100), (dm_x + 8, input_box_y, dm_w - 16, 32), 1)

        cursor = "_" if (pygame.time.get_ticks() // 500) % 2 == 0 else " "

        input_display = _dm_input + cursor

        if not _dm_input:

            input_display = "Type a message..."

            in_col = (90, 100, 110)

        else:

            in_col = C_WHITE

        ins = font_terminal_small.render(input_display, True, in_col)

        screen.blit(ins, (dm_x + 16, input_box_y + 10))

        send_hint = font_terminal_small.render(

            "[ENTER] send  \u00b7  [ESC] close DM",

            True, (90, 110, 120),

        )

        screen.blit(send_hint, (dm_x + 12, dm_y + dm_h + 4))

def scroll_server_list(direction):

    """direction: +1 scrolls down, -1 scrolls up."""

    global _scroll_offset

    max_offset = max(0, len(server_list) - 1)

    _scroll_offset = max(0, min(max_offset, _scroll_offset + direction))

def scroll_dm_list(direction):

    global _dm_scroll_offset

    list_bottom_limit = SERVER_PANEL_Y + SERVER_PANEL_H - 90

    list_y = SERVER_LIST_TOP - 4

    row_h = 38

    visible_friends = (list_bottom_limit - list_y) // row_h

    max_offset = max(0, len(CONNECTIONS) - visible_friends)

    _dm_scroll_offset = max(0, min(max_offset, _dm_scroll_offset + direction))

def trigger_server_refresh():

    global _refresh_active, _refresh_progress

    if not _refresh_active:

        _refresh_active = True

        _refresh_progress = 0.0

        audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.4)

def get_kick_message_for_server(server_name):

    if server_name in KICK_MESSAGES_BY_SERVER:

        return random.choice(KICK_MESSAGES_BY_SERVER[server_name])

    return random.choice(KICK_MESSAGES)

_server_shade = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

_server_shade.fill((0, 0, 0, 115))

_server_panel = pygame.Surface((SERVER_PANEL_W, SERVER_PANEL_H), pygame.SRCALPHA)

_server_panel.fill((7, 10, 13, 236))

pygame.draw.rect(_server_panel, (38, 58, 70, 170), _server_panel.get_rect(), 1)

pygame.draw.rect(_server_panel, (255, 120, 0, 90), (0, 0, SERVER_PANEL_W, 3))

def _wrap_server_name(name, font, max_width, max_lines=2):

    """Wrap a server name into up to max_lines lines.

    Returns a list of rendered strings (1 or 2 elements)."""

    if font.size(name)[0] <= max_width:

        return [name]

    words = name.split(" ")

    if len(words) > 1:

        best_split = 1

        for i in range(1, len(words)):

            first = " ".join(words[:i])

            if font.size(first)[0] <= max_width:

                best_split = i

            else:

                break

        line1 = " ".join(words[:best_split])

        line2 = " ".join(words[best_split:])

        if font.size(line2)[0] > max_width:

            ellipsis = "..."

            while line2 and font.size(line2 + ellipsis)[0] > max_width:

                line2 = line2[:-1]

            line2 = line2 + ellipsis

        return [line1, line2]

    mid = len(name) // 2

    while mid > 1 and font.size(name[:mid])[0] > max_width:

        mid -= 1

    line1 = name[:mid]

    line2 = name[mid:]

    if font.size(line2)[0] > max_width:

        ellipsis = "..."

        while line2 and font.size(line2 + ellipsis)[0] > max_width:

            line2 = line2[:-1]

        line2 = line2 + ellipsis

    return [line1, line2]

def draw_server_browser(selected_idx, connecting, kicked_msg, connect_progress=0.0):

    draw_menu_background()

    screen.blit(_server_shade, (0, 0))

    screen.blit(_server_panel, (SERVER_PANEL_X, SERVER_PANEL_Y))

    # ── Faint horizontal grid behind list ──

    for gy in range(SERVER_LIST_TOP + 50, SERVER_PANEL_Y + SERVER_PANEL_H - 80, 50):

        pygame.draw.line(

            screen, (15, 27, 34),

            (SERVER_ROW_X, gy),

            (SERVER_ROW_X + SERVER_ROW_W, gy), 1,

        )

    # ── Title ──

    screen.blit(_server_title_font.render("SERVER BROWSER", True, (0, 0, 0)), (SERVER_PANEL_X + 30, SERVER_PANEL_Y + 25))

    screen.blit(_server_title_font.render("SERVER BROWSER", True, C_WHITE), (SERVER_PANEL_X + 28, SERVER_PANEL_Y + 22))

    subtitle = font_terminal_small.render(

        f"KRAPNET regional lobbies  ·  {len(server_list)} servers online",

        True, (95, 125, 145),

    )

    screen.blit(subtitle, (SERVER_PANEL_X + 31, SERVER_PANEL_Y + 79))

    # ── Tabs (SERVERS / CONNECTIONS) ──

    tab_y = SERVER_PANEL_Y + 120

    servers_tab_rect.x = SERVER_PANEL_X + 28

    servers_tab_rect.y = tab_y

    connections_tab_rect.x = SERVER_PANEL_X + 28 + servers_tab_rect.w + 4

    connections_tab_rect.y = tab_y

    for tab_name, tab_rect in [("SERVERS", servers_tab_rect), ("CONNECTIONS", connections_tab_rect)]:

        is_active = _mp_tab == tab_name

        hover = tab_rect.collidepoint(get_scaled_mouse())

        if is_active:

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (28, 38, 48), tab_rect)

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, C_ORANGE, tab_rect, 1)

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, C_ORANGE, (tab_rect.x, tab_rect.bottom - 2, tab_rect.w, 2))

        else:

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (10, 16, 22), tab_rect)

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (50, 70, 85) if hover else (28, 44, 56), tab_rect, 1)

        label_text = tab_name

        if tab_name == "CONNECTIONS":

            online = sum(1 for c in CONNECTIONS if "Online" in c["status"])

            label_text = f"CONNECTIONS  ({online})"

        ts = font_terminal_small.render(label_text, True, C_WHITE if (is_active or hover) else (150, 160, 170))

        screen.blit(ts, (tab_rect.centerx - ts.get_width() // 2, tab_rect.centery - ts.get_height() // 2))

    # ── Refresh button ──

    refresh_hover = refresh_btn_rect.collidepoint(get_scaled_mouse())

    refresh_bg = (40, 50, 60, 220) if refresh_hover else (20, 30, 40, 200)

    btn_surf = pygame.Surface((refresh_btn_rect.w, refresh_btn_rect.h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    btn_surf.fill(refresh_bg)

    pygame.draw.rect(btn_surf, C_ORANGE if refresh_hover else (80, 100, 120), btn_surf.get_rect(), 1)

    screen.blit(btn_surf, refresh_btn_rect)

    if _refresh_active:

        fw = int(refresh_btn_rect.w * _refresh_progress)

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (255, 120, 0, 100), (refresh_btn_rect.x, refresh_btn_rect.y, fw, refresh_btn_rect.h))

        rt = font_terminal_small.render("SCANNING...", True, C_ORANGE)

    else:

        rt = font_terminal_small.render("[REFRESH]", True, C_ORANGE if refresh_hover else (180, 180, 190))

    screen.blit(rt, (refresh_btn_rect.centerx - rt.get_width() // 2, refresh_btn_rect.centery - rt.get_height() // 2))

    mouse_pos = get_scaled_mouse()

    if _mp_tab == "SERVERS":

        # ── Divider under header ──

        pygame.draw.line(

            screen, C_ORANGE,

            (SERVER_PANEL_X + 28, SERVER_PANEL_Y + 156),

            (SERVER_PANEL_X + SERVER_PANEL_W - 28, SERVER_PANEL_Y + 156), 1,

        )

        # ── Column headers (above list) ──

        header_y = SERVER_LIST_TOP - 22

        status_x = SERVER_ROW_X + 320

        players_x = SERVER_ROW_X + 402

        ping_x = SERVER_ROW_X + 468

        headers = [

            ("SERVER", SERVER_ROW_X + 14),

            ("STATUS", status_x + 5),

            ("PLAYERS", players_x),

            ("PING", ping_x),

        ]

        for label, hx in headers:

            screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (80, 130, 160)), (hx, header_y))

        # ── Server list (left side) — rows can be 1 or 2 lines tall ──

        visible_count = 5

        hovered_server_idx = -1

        list_top = SERVER_LIST_TOP

        SERVER_ROW_H_SINGLE = 50

        SERVER_ROW_H_DOUBLE = 64

        ROW_GAP = 5

        name_max_width = (status_x - SERVER_ROW_X) - 24

        row_layouts = []

        cur_y = list_top

        for vi in range(visible_count):

            i = vi + _scroll_offset

            if i >= len(server_list):

                break

            name = server_list[i][0]

            name_lines = _wrap_server_name(name, font_terminal, name_max_width)

            row_h = SERVER_ROW_H_DOUBLE if len(name_lines) > 1 else SERVER_ROW_H_SINGLE

            row_layouts.append((i, name_lines, row_h, cur_y))

            cur_y += row_h + ROW_GAP

        list_bottom = cur_y

        for i, name_lines, row_h, ry in row_layouts:

            name, cur, max_p, ping = server_list[i]

            row_rect = pygame.Rect(SERVER_ROW_X, ry, SERVER_ROW_W, row_h - 4)

            hover = row_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos) and not _refresh_active and not connecting and not kicked_msg

            if hover:

                hovered_server_idx = i

            status, status_color = _server_status(cur, max_p, ping)

            row_surf = pygame.Surface((SERVER_ROW_W, row_h - 4), pygame.SRCALPHA)

            if i == selected_idx:

                row_surf.fill((28, 36, 42, 235))

                pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, C_ORANGE, row_surf.get_rect(), 1)

                pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, (255, 120, 0, 130), (0, 0, 4, row_h - 4))

            elif hover:

                row_surf.fill((18, 28, 34, 225))

                pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, (80, 120, 140), row_surf.get_rect(), 1)

            else:

                row_surf.fill((9, 14, 18, 210))

                pygame.draw.rect(row_surf, (28, 44, 56), row_surf.get_rect(), 1)

            if _refresh_active:

                fade = pygame.Surface((SERVER_ROW_W, row_h - 4), pygame.SRCALPHA)

                fade.fill((0, 0, 0, 140))

                row_surf.blit(fade, (0, 0))

            screen.blit(row_surf, row_rect)

            name_color = C_WHITE if (hover or i == selected_idx) and not _refresh_active else (195, 205, 210)

            for li, line in enumerate(name_lines):

                line_surf = font_terminal.render(line, True, name_color)

                screen.blit(line_surf, (SERVER_ROW_X + 12, ry + 6 + li * 20))

            region_y_base = ry + 6 + len(name_lines) * 20

            region_idx = (sum(ord(c) for c in name) + i) % len(SERVER_REGIONS)

            region = font_terminal_small.render(SERVER_REGIONS[region_idx], True, (80, 95, 105))

            screen.blit(region, (SERVER_ROW_X + 13, region_y_base + 2))

            center_y = ry + (row_h - 4) // 2 - 11

            _draw_server_badge(status, status_color, status_x, center_y)

            pc = font_terminal.render(f"{cur:02d}/{max_p:02d}", True, C_ORANGE if cur >= max_p else C_TERMINAL)

            ping_c = (100, 200, 100) if ping < 60 else ((200, 200, 100) if ping < 150 else (200, 100, 100))

            ping_t = font_terminal.render(f"{ping}ms", True, ping_c)

            screen.blit(pc, (players_x, center_y + 1))

            screen.blit(ping_t, (ping_x, center_y + 1))

            bar_x = ping_x

            bar_y = center_y + 22

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (25, 28, 30), (bar_x, bar_y, 42, 4))

            fill_w = max(6, min(42, int(42 * (1 - min(ping, 240) / 240))))

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, ping_c, (bar_x, bar_y, fill_w, 4))

        if len(server_list) > visible_count:

            sb_x = SERVER_ROW_X + SERVER_ROW_W + 8

            sb_y = list_top

            sb_h = list_bottom - list_top - ROW_GAP

            sb_w = 5

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 22, 28), (sb_x, sb_y, sb_w, sb_h))

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (28, 44, 56), (sb_x, sb_y, sb_w, sb_h), 1)

            thumb_ratio = visible_count / len(server_list)

            thumb_h = max(20, int(sb_h * thumb_ratio))

            max_scroll = max(1, len(server_list) - visible_count)

            thumb_y = sb_y + int((sb_h - thumb_h) * (_scroll_offset / max_scroll))

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, C_ORANGE, (sb_x, thumb_y, sb_w, thumb_h))

        # ── Scroll indicators (bottom of list, right-aligned to avoid BACK button) ──

        rendered_count = len(row_layouts)

        remaining_below = len(server_list) - (_scroll_offset + rendered_count)

        remaining_above = _scroll_offset

        if remaining_below > 0 or remaining_above > 0:

            if remaining_below > 0 and remaining_above > 0:

                hint_text = f"\u25b2 {remaining_above} above  \u00b7  \u25bc {remaining_below} below  \u00b7  scroll wheel"

            elif remaining_below > 0:

                hint_text = f"\u25bc {remaining_below} more servers  \u00b7  scroll wheel"

            else:

                hint_text = f"\u25b2 {remaining_above} above  \u00b7  scroll wheel"

            more_hint = font_terminal_small.render(hint_text, True, (90, 110, 130))

            screen.blit(

                more_hint,

                (

                    SERVER_ROW_X + SERVER_ROW_W - more_hint.get_width() - 4,

                    list_bottom + 4,

                ),

            )

        # ── Vertical Chat Panel (right side) ──

        chat_bg = pygame.Surface((CHAT_PANEL_W, CHAT_PANEL_H), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        chat_bg.fill((4, 8, 12, 215))

        pygame.draw.rect(chat_bg, (30, 50, 60), chat_bg.get_rect(), 1)

        pygame.draw.rect(chat_bg, (80, 130, 160, 90), (0, 0, CHAT_PANEL_W, 2))

        screen.blit(chat_bg, (CHAT_PANEL_X, CHAT_PANEL_Y))

        chat_lbl = font_terminal_small.render("// GLOBAL CHAT //", True, (80, 130, 160))

        screen.blit(chat_lbl, (CHAT_PANEL_X + 10, CHAT_PANEL_Y + 8))

        online_dot_pulse = (pygame.time.get_ticks() // 500) % 2

        dot_col = (80, 220, 100) if online_dot_pulse else (40, 140, 70)

        pygame.draw.circle(screen, dot_col, (CHAT_PANEL_X + CHAT_PANEL_W - 22, CHAT_PANEL_Y + 14), 3)

        online_lbl = font_terminal_small.render("LIVE", True, (80, 130, 100))

        screen.blit(online_lbl, (CHAT_PANEL_X + CHAT_PANEL_W - 60, CHAT_PANEL_Y + 8))

        pygame.draw.line(

            screen, (30, 50, 60),

            (CHAT_PANEL_X + 8, CHAT_PANEL_Y + 28),

            (CHAT_PANEL_X + CHAT_PANEL_W - 8, CHAT_PANEL_Y + 28), 1,

        )

        msg_area_x = CHAT_PANEL_X + 10

        msg_area_y = CHAT_PANEL_Y + 36

        msg_area_w = CHAT_PANEL_W - 20

        msg_area_h = CHAT_PANEL_H - 60

        rendered_lines = []

        for msg in _chat_messages:

            alpha = min(255, msg["age"] * 13)

            user_text = f"[{msg['user']}]"

            body_text = msg["text"]

            user_surf = font_terminal_small.render(user_text, True, msg["color"])

            user_surf.set_alpha(alpha)

            rendered_lines.append([(user_surf, msg_area_x, alpha)])

            words = body_text.split(" ")

            line = ""

            for w in words:

                test = (line + " " + w).strip() if line else w

                if font_terminal_small.size(test)[0] <= msg_area_w - 12:

                    line = test

                else:

                    if line:

                        s = font_terminal_small.render(line, True, (200, 200, 205))

                        s.set_alpha(alpha)

                        rendered_lines.append([(s, msg_area_x + 12, alpha)])

                    line = w

            if line:

                s = font_terminal_small.render(line, True, (200, 200, 205))

                s.set_alpha(alpha)

                rendered_lines.append([(s, msg_area_x + 12, alpha)])

            rendered_lines.append([])

        line_h = 14

        max_lines = msg_area_h // line_h

        visible_lines = rendered_lines[-max_lines:]

        for li, line_entries in enumerate(visible_lines):

            ly = msg_area_y + li * line_h

            for surf, x, _ in line_entries:

                screen.blit(surf, (x, ly))

        typing_y = CHAT_PANEL_Y + CHAT_PANEL_H - 18

        pygame.draw.line(

            screen, (30, 50, 60),

            (CHAT_PANEL_X + 8, typing_y - 4),

            (CHAT_PANEL_X + CHAT_PANEL_W - 8, typing_y - 4), 1,

        )

        typing_dots = "." * ((pygame.time.get_ticks() // 400) % 4)

        typing_users = [

            "Volkov_Real", "admin", "noob123", "MaruWatches", "Sebi_PM",

            "VasileFan2007", "xX_KRAP_Xx", "Cigarette_Enjoyer", "MOD_Krapov",

            "OldFisherman", "ConspiracyGuy", "MAGRecruiter", "Cmdr_VodkaTime",

            "RushB_Acaristan", "EX_KRAP_OPERATOR", "CapsLock_Stuck",

        ]

        typing_user = typing_users[(pygame.time.get_ticks() // 4000) % len(typing_users)]

        typing_lbl = font_terminal_small.render(

            f"{typing_user} is typing{typing_dots}", True, (90, 110, 120),

        )

        screen.blit(typing_lbl, (CHAT_PANEL_X + 10, typing_y))

        if hovered_server_idx >= 0 and not _refresh_active and not connecting and not kicked_msg:

            name = server_list[hovered_server_idx][0]

            rules = SERVER_RULES.get(name)

            if rules:

                tip_w = 360

                tip_h = 22 + len(rules) * 16 + 12

                tip_x = min(mouse_pos[0] + 16, WIDTH - tip_w - 10)

                tip_y = min(mouse_pos[1] + 16, HEIGHT - tip_h - 10)

                tip_surf = pygame.Surface((tip_w, tip_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

                tip_surf.fill((6, 10, 14, 245))

                pygame.draw.rect(tip_surf, C_ORANGE, tip_surf.get_rect(), 1)

                pygame.draw.rect(tip_surf, (255, 120, 0, 100), (0, 0, tip_w, 3))

                screen.blit(tip_surf, (tip_x, tip_y))

                tlbl = font_terminal_small.render("SERVER INFO", True, C_ORANGE)

                screen.blit(tlbl, (tip_x + 10, tip_y + 6))

                for li, line in enumerate(rules):

                    col = (200, 200, 210) if not line.startswith(" ") else (140, 140, 150)

                    ls = font_terminal_small.render(line, True, col)

                    screen.blit(ls, (tip_x + 10, tip_y + 24 + li * 16))

    else:

        draw_connections_panel()

    # ── Back button ──

    server_back_btn.x = SERVER_PANEL_X + 28

    server_back_btn.y = SERVER_PANEL_Y + SERVER_PANEL_H - 62

    server_back_btn.width = 150

    server_back_btn.rect.x = server_back_btn.x

    server_back_btn.rect.y = server_back_btn.y

    server_back_btn.rect.width = server_back_btn.width

    server_back_btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

    server_back_btn.draw(screen)

    hint = font_terminal_small.render("ESC returns to menu", True, (95, 110, 120))

    screen.blit(hint, (SERVER_PANEL_X + SERVER_PANEL_W - hint.get_width() - 28, SERVER_PANEL_Y + SERVER_PANEL_H - 48))

    # ── Connecting popup ──

    if connecting:

        popup = pygame.Surface((460, 220), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        popup.fill((8, 11, 16, 248))

        popup_rect = popup.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2))

        pygame.draw.rect(popup, C_ORANGE, popup.get_rect(), 1)

        pygame.draw.rect(popup, (255, 120, 0, 120), (0, 0, 460, 3))

        progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(connect_progress or 0.0)))

        t = font_speaker.render(f"CONNECTING{dots}", True, C_ORANGE)

        screen.blit(t, (popup_rect.x + 28, popup_rect.y + 18))

        pct = font_terminal_small.render(f"{int(progress * 100):02d}%", True, (120, 160, 175))

        screen.blit(pct, (popup_rect.right - pct.get_width() - 30, popup_rect.y + 28))

        log_lines = [

            (0.00, "Resolving krapnet.acaristan.gov..."),

            (0.16, "Handshake established"),

            (0.32, "Verifying loyalty token..."),

            (0.50, "Bypassing IPA firewall..."),

            (0.88, "Almost there..."),

            active = progress >= threshold

            ly += 18

        fill_w = int(400 * progress)

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, C_ORANGE, (popup_rect.x + 30, popup_rect.y + 180, fill_w, 10))

        # Small moving scan highlight inside the filled portion; does not affect progress.

        if fill_w > 12:

            scan_x = popup_rect.x + 30 + int((pygame.time.get_ticks() * 0.12) % max(1, fill_w))

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (255, 190, 80), (scan_x, popup_rect.y + 180, min(18, fill_w), 10))

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (80, 70, 55), (popup_rect.x + 30, popup_rect.y + 180, 400, 10), 1)

    elif kicked_msg:

        popup_w, popup_h = 460, 220

        popup = pygame.Surface((popup_w, popup_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        popup.fill((15, 10, 10, 245))

        popup_rect = popup.get_rect(center=(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2))

                line = test

            else:

                    lines.append(line)

                line = w

            lt = font_terminal.render(ln, True, (220, 200, 200))

            screen.blit(lt, (popup_rect.x + 30, popup_rect.y + 88 + j * 24))

        kick_dismiss_btn_rect.x = popup_rect.centerx - kick_dismiss_btn_rect.w // 2

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, outline_col, kick_dismiss_btn_rect, 1, border_radius=3)

        ok = font_btn.render("DISMISS", True, C_WHITE if btn_hover else (200, 180, 180))

        screen.blit(

            ok,

            (

                kick_dismiss_btn_rect.centerx - ok.get_width() // 2,

                kick_dismiss_btn_rect.centery - ok.get_height() // 2,

            ),

        )

        hint2 = font_terminal_small.render("[ESC] also dismisses", True, (110, 70, 70))

        screen.blit(

            hint2,

            (

                popup_rect.centerx - hint2.get_width() // 2,

                kick_dismiss_btn_rect.bottom + 4,

            ),

        )

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

# CRT terminal drawing helpers

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def _draw_arrow_btn(rect, sym):

    """Arrow button with CRT phosphor glow on hover."""

    hover = rect.collidepoint(get_scaled_mouse())

    bg = (18, 50, 28) if hover else (10, 22, 14)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, bg, rect)

    border_col = (80, 220, 120) if hover else (30, 70, 40)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, border_col, rect, 1)

    c = font_btn.render(sym, True, (140, 240, 160) if hover else (90, 170, 110))

    screen.blit(c, (rect.centerx - c.get_width() // 2, rect.centery - c.get_height() // 2))





def _draw_volume_slider(label, bar_rect, left_rect, right_rect, value, row_y):

    """Volume/brightness slider with CRT phosphor fill."""

    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (110, 180, 130)), (LABEL_X, row_y + 3))

    _draw_arrow_btn(left_rect, "<")

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (6, 12, 8), bar_rect)

    fill_w = int(bar_rect.width * value / 100)

    if fill_w > 0:

        screen.blit(_VOL_GRADIENT, bar_rect.topleft, (0, 0, fill_w, bar_rect.height))

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (30, 70, 40), bar_rect, 1)

    _draw_arrow_btn(right_rect, ">")

    pct = font_terminal.render(f"{value:>3}%", True, (140, 240, 160))

    screen.blit(pct, (right_rect.right + 12, row_y))





def _draw_toggle(label, rect, value, row_y):

    """CRT toggle switch — green when ON, dim when OFF."""

    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (110, 180, 130)), (LABEL_X, row_y + 3))

    hover = rect.collidepoint(get_scaled_mouse())

    on_col = (50, 160, 80) if value else (18, 22, 18)

    border_col = (80, 220, 120) if (hover or value) else (40, 50, 42)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, on_col, rect)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, border_col, rect, 1)

    # Knob

    knob_x = rect.right - 22 if value else rect.x + 4

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (200, 250, 210) if value else (90, 100, 95),

                     (knob_x, rect.y + 4, 18, rect.height - 8))

    state_label = "ON" if value else "OFF"

    s = font_terminal_small.render(state_label, True, (140, 240, 160) if value else (120, 120, 115))

    screen.blit(s, (rect.right + 12, row_y + 3))





def _draw_stepper(label, left_rect, right_rect, value_str, row_y):

    """Stepper control: < VALUE >  for enumerated settings (resolution, mode, etc.)."""

    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (110, 180, 130)), (LABEL_X, row_y + 3))

    _draw_arrow_btn(left_rect, "<")

    val_surf = font_terminal.render(value_str, True, (140, 240, 160))

    val_cx = (left_rect.right + right_rect.left) // 2

    screen.blit(val_surf, (val_cx - val_surf.get_width() // 2, row_y))

    _draw_arrow_btn(right_rect, ">")





def _draw_section_header(text, y):

    """Small green section divider with a label — groups related settings."""

    header = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, (80, 200, 120))

    screen.blit(header, (LABEL_X, y))

    line_y = y + header.get_height() + 2

    pygame.draw.line(screen, (25, 60, 35), (LABEL_X, line_y),

                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 48, line_y), 1)





def _draw_hint(text, y):

    """Dim helper text under a setting."""

    hint = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, (90, 110, 100))

    screen.blit(hint, (LABEL_X, y))





def draw_settings(active_tab, display_mode, res_idx,

                  master_volume, music_volume, sfx_volume, mute_on_focus_loss,

                  crosshair, crosshair_size, auto_reload, aim_assist, subtitles,

                  brightness, scanlines, grain, particle_density,

                  mouse_sensitivity, invert_mouse,

                  reduced_motion, colorblind_mode):

    """Render the settings overlay — CRT terminal style, 6 tabs."""

    screen.blit(_settings_overlay, (0, 0))

    screen.blit(_settings_panel, (SETTINGS_PANEL_X, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y))



    # ── Title with CRT phosphor glow ──

    title_surf = font_speaker.render("SETTINGS", True, (140, 240, 160))

    title_x = SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W // 2 - title_surf.get_width() // 2

    # Glow underlay (blurred green)

    glow = font_speaker.render("SETTINGS", True, (30, 90, 50))

    screen.blit(glow, (title_x + 1, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 24))

    screen.blit(title_surf, (title_x, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 23))

    pygame.draw.line(screen, (50, 140, 80),

                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + 80, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 64),

                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 80, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 64), 1)



    # ── Tab bar ──

    mouse = get_scaled_mouse()

    for i, (rect, label) in enumerate(zip(settings_tab_rects, SETTINGS_TABS)):

        is_active = (i == active_tab)

        hover = rect.collidepoint(mouse)

        bg = (14, 40, 22) if is_active else ((10, 20, 14) if hover else (6, 12, 8))

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, bg, rect)

        if is_active:

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (80, 220, 120), (rect.x, rect.bottom - 3, rect.width, 3))

        else:

            pygame.draw.line(screen, (25, 50, 32), (rect.x, rect.bottom), (rect.right, rect.bottom), 1)

        col = (140, 240, 160) if is_active else ((110, 160, 120) if hover else (80, 110, 90))

        ts = font_terminal_small.render(label, True, col)

        screen.blit(ts, (rect.centerx - ts.get_width() // 2, rect.centery - ts.get_height() // 2))



    # ── Tab content ──

    if active_tab == 0:

        # DISPLAY

        _draw_section_header("MONITOR", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_stepper("Resolution", settings_res_left_rect, settings_res_right_rect,

                      SETTINGS_RESOLUTIONS[res_idx] if res_idx < len(SETTINGS_RESOLUTIONS) else "N/A",

                      ROW_RES_Y)

        _draw_stepper("Display Mode", settings_display_left_rect, settings_display_right_rect,

                      DISPLAY_MODES[display_mode] if display_mode < len(DISPLAY_MODES) else "N/A",

                      ROW_DISPLAY_Y)

        _draw_hint("Press F11 to toggle fullscreen at any time.", ROW_DISPLAY_Y + 38)



    elif active_tab == 1:

        # AUDIO

        _draw_section_header("LEVELS", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("Master Volume", settings_master_bar_rect,

                            settings_master_left_rect, settings_master_right_rect,

                            master_volume, ROW_MASTER_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("Music Volume", settings_music_bar_rect,

                            settings_music_left_rect, settings_music_right_rect,

                            music_volume, ROW_MUSIC_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("SFX Volume", settings_sfx_bar_rect,

                            settings_sfx_left_rect, settings_sfx_right_rect,

                            sfx_volume, ROW_SFX_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Mute on Focus Loss", settings_mute_rect,

                     mute_on_focus_loss, ROW_MUTE_Y)

        _draw_hint("Silences all audio when the window loses focus.", ROW_MUTE_Y + 36)



    elif active_tab == 2:

        # GAMEPLAY

        _draw_section_header("COMBAT", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Crosshair", settings_crosshair_rect, crosshair, ROW_CROSSHAIR_Y)

        _draw_stepper("Crosshair Size", settings_crosshair_size_left, settings_crosshair_size_right,

                      CROSSHAIR_SIZE_LABELS[CROSSHAIR_SIZES.index(crosshair_size)] if crosshair_size in CROSSHAIR_SIZES else "MEDIUM",

                      ROW_CROSSHAIR_SIZE_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Auto-Reload", settings_auto_reload_rect, auto_reload, ROW_AUTO_RELOAD_Y)

        _draw_hint("Automatically reload when the magazine runs dry.", ROW_AUTO_RELOAD_Y + 36)

        _draw_toggle("Aim Assist", settings_aim_assist_rect, aim_assist, ROW_AIM_ASSIST_Y)

        _draw_hint("Subtly pulls the aim toward nearby enemies.", ROW_AIM_ASSIST_Y + 36)

        _draw_section_header("PRESENTATION", ROW_SUBTITLES_Y - 24)

        _draw_toggle("Subtitles", settings_subtitles_rect, subtitles, ROW_SUBTITLES_Y)

        _draw_hint("Shows spoken dialogue as on-screen text.", ROW_SUBTITLES_Y + 36)



    elif active_tab == 3:

        # GRAPHICS

        _draw_section_header("IMAGE", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("Brightness", settings_brightness_bar,

                            settings_brightness_left, settings_brightness_right,

                            brightness, ROW_BRIGHTNESS_Y)

        _draw_hint("Adjusts the overall image brightness. 50 = default.", ROW_BRIGHTNESS_Y + 36)

        _draw_section_header("POST-PROCESSING", ROW_SCANLINES_Y - 24)

        _draw_toggle("Scanlines", settings_scanlines_rect, scanlines, ROW_SCANLINES_Y)

        _draw_hint("CRT horizontal scanline overlay.", ROW_SCANLINES_Y + 36)

        _draw_toggle("Film Grain", settings_grain_rect, grain, ROW_GRAIN_Y)

        _draw_hint("Animated grain texture over the screen.", ROW_GRAIN_Y + 36)

        _draw_volume_slider("Particle Density", settings_particles_bar,

                            settings_particles_left, settings_particles_right,

                            particle_density, ROW_PARTICLES_Y)

        _draw_hint("Scales the number of particles (explosions, smoke, blood).", ROW_PARTICLES_Y + 36)



    elif active_tab == 4:

        # CONTROLS

        _draw_section_header("MOUSE", CONTENT_Y)

        # NOTE: Mouse Sensitivity and Invert Mouse Y were previously shown
        # here as a slider + toggle, but the game uses cursor-based aiming
        # (math.atan2 of absolute mouse position relative to the player) —
        # there's no delta-look code path to scale, and no Y-axis look to
        # invert. The controls saved values to disk but never applied them,
        # which made the settings feel broken. Removed until a real input
        # model exists that can consume them.

        _draw_hint("Aiming is cursor-based — your crosshair follows the mouse", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y)
        _draw_hint("pointer directly. Mouse sensitivity and inversion do not", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 22)
        _draw_hint("apply in this control scheme.", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 44)

        _draw_section_header("KEYBINDS", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 80)

        _draw_hint("Key remapping is not yet available in this build.", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 112)

        _draw_hint("Default: WASD move · LMB shoot · R reload · G molotov · E interact", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 130)

        _draw_hint("              Q swap weapon · F melee · ESC pause", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 148)



    else:

        # ACCESSIBILITY

        _draw_section_header("MOTION", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Reduced Motion", settings_reduced_motion_rect,

                     reduced_motion, ROW_REDUCED_MOTION_Y)

        _draw_hint("Disables screen shake and bright full-screen flashes.", ROW_REDUCED_MOTION_Y + 36)

        _draw_section_header("VISION", ROW_COLORBLIND_Y - 24)

        _draw_stepper("Colorblind Mode", settings_colorblind_left, settings_colorblind_right,

                      COLORBLIND_MODES[colorblind_mode] if colorblind_mode < len(COLORBLIND_MODES) else "OFF",

                      ROW_COLORBLIND_Y)

        _draw_hint("Adjusts UI colors for color vision deficiency.", ROW_COLORBLIND_Y + 38)



    # ── CRT scanlines over the whole panel ──

    screen.blit(_CRT_SCANLINES, (SETTINGS_PANEL_X, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y))



    # ── Back + Apply buttons ──

    btn_y = SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + SETTINGS_PANEL_H - 52

    settings_back_btn.x = SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W // 2 - 230

    settings_back_btn.y = btn_y

    settings_back_btn.width = 210

    settings_back_btn.rect = pygame.Rect(settings_back_btn.x, settings_back_btn.y, 210, 38)

    settings_back_btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

    settings_back_btn.draw(screen)



    settings_apply_btn.x = SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W // 2 + 20

    settings_apply_btn.y = btn_y

    settings_apply_btn.width = 210

    settings_apply_btn.rect = pygame.Rect(settings_apply_btn.x, settings_apply_btn.y, 210, 38)

    settings_apply_btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

    settings_apply_btn.draw(screen)
