# Pause buttons moved down to make room for a proper title + mission status
# block. The original positions (280/340/400) left the pause menu as just a
# flat overlay with "PAUSED" text + 3 naked buttons — visually jarring next
# to the polished main menu and death screen.
#
# Layout (screen Y coordinates):
#   Panel:     y=70 to y=630 (560 tall)
#   Banner:    y=92
#   Title:     y=135 (Impact 80, bottom ~215)
#   Accent:    y=220
#   Op name:   y=235
#   Header:    y=265
#   Divider:   y=283
#   Status:    y=298, 324, 350, 376 (4 rows, bottom ~394)
#   Buttons:   y=410, 460, 510, 560 (4 buttons, 50px apart, bottom ~600)
#   Footer:    y=608
#
# 4 buttons: RESUME, SETTINGS, RESTART MISSION, QUIT TO MENU.
# SETTINGS was added so the user can adjust options mid-mission without
# quitting. The SETTINGS state returns to PAUSED (not MENU) when entered
# from the pause menu — see _settings_return_to in acaristan.py.

pause_buttons = [

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 410, "RESUME"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 460, "SETTINGS"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 510, "RESTART MISSION"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 560, "QUIT TO MENU"),

]

death_buttons = [

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 330, "RESTART MISSION"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 390, "QUIT TO MENU"),

]

# Darker overlay for the pause screen — 200 alpha makes the frozen gameplay
# recede more than the old 180, giving the panel better contrast.
_pause_overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

_pause_overlay.fill((0, 0, 0, 200))

# Cached panel frame: border + corner ticks + classification banner + title +
# accent bar + footer. These never change during a pause session, so we build
# them once. Dynamic content (operation name, status block, buttons) is drawn
# on top each frame.
_pause_panel_w, _pause_panel_h = 560, 560

_pause_panel_x = (WIDTH - _pause_panel_w) // 2

_pause_panel_y = 70

_pause_panel_frame = pygame.Surface((_pause_panel_w, _pause_panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

# Panel background — slightly lighter than the full-screen overlay so the
# panel reads as a distinct surface.
_pause_panel_frame.fill((8, 10, 14, 210))

# Orange border (2px) + inner dim border (1px) — matches the settings panel
# treatment in draw_settings().
pygame.draw.rect(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, _pause_panel_frame.get_rect(), 2)

pygame.draw.rect(_pause_panel_frame, (90, 50, 20), _pause_panel_frame.get_rect().inflate(-4, -4), 1)

# Corner ticks — matching the main menu _menu_overlay corner accent style.
for cx, cy in [(10, 10), (_pause_panel_w - 10, 10), (10, _pause_panel_h - 10), (_pause_panel_w - 10, _pause_panel_h - 10)]:

    dx = 1 if cx < _pause_panel_w // 2 else -1

    dy = 1 if cy < _pause_panel_h // 2 else -1

    pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (cx, cy), (cx + dx * 16, cy), 2)

    pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (cx, cy), (cx, cy + dy * 16), 2)

# Classification banner at top of panel — matches the main menu's banner.
_banner_y = 22

pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (30, _banner_y), (_pause_panel_w - 30, _banner_y), 1)

pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (30, _banner_y + 24), (_pause_panel_w - 30, _banner_y + 24), 1)

_banner_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 11, bold=True)

_banner_text = _banner_font.render("// KRAPNET TERMINAL — OPERATION SUSPENDED //", True, C_ORANGE)

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_banner_text, ((_pause_panel_w - _banner_text.get_width()) // 2, _banner_y + 5))

# "PAUSED" title — Impact 80 with drop shadow, matching the main menu title.
# Panel-relative Y=65 → screen Y = _pause_panel_y + 65 = 135.
_title_y = 65

_title_shadow = font_title.render("PAUSED", True, (0, 0, 0))

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_title_shadow, ((_pause_panel_w - _title_shadow.get_width()) // 2 + 4, _title_y + 4))

_title_main = font_title.render("PAUSED", True, C_WHITE)

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_title_main, ((_pause_panel_w - _title_main.get_width()) // 2, _title_y))

# Orange accent bar under title — matches the main menu's accent bar.
_bar_y = _title_y + 88

pygame.draw.rect(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, ((_pause_panel_w - 200) // 2, _bar_y, 200, 3))

# Footer hint at bottom of panel.
_footer_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 12)

_footer_text = _footer_font.render("ESC — RESUME    ·    F11 — TOGGLE FULLSCREEN", True, (100, 100, 100))

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_footer_text, ((_pause_panel_w - _footer_text.get_width()) // 2, _pause_panel_h - 22))

# Small status-block font (reused for the dynamic rows).
_pause_stat_label_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 13, bold=True)

_pause_stat_value_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 18, bold=True)


def _format_elapsed(seconds):
    """mm:ss for the elapsed-time stat."""
    m = int(seconds) // 60
    s = int(seconds) % 60
    return f"{m:02d}:{s:02d}"


def draw_pause_menu():
    """Draw the pause overlay + framed panel + mission status + buttons.

    Redesigned from the original 3-line placeholder (flat overlay + "PAUSED"
    text + naked buttons) to match the main menu's visual language: framed
    panel with corner ticks, classification banner, Impact title with drop
    shadow + orange accent bar, operation subtitle, live mission status
    block (elapsed time / hostiles / accuracy / ammo), and the same
    ModernButton style used everywhere else.
    """

    screen.blit(_pause_overlay, (0, 0))

    screen.blit(_pause_panel_frame, (_pause_panel_x, _pause_panel_y))

    # ── Operation subtitle (dynamic — depends on current mission) ──
    op_name = getattr(STATE, "active_mission_operation", "WAREHOUSE RAID — BLACK NOTEBOOK")

    op_surf = font_terminal.render(op_name, True, C_TERMINAL)

    screen.blit(op_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - op_surf.get_width() // 2, _pause_panel_y + 165))

    # ── Mission status header ──
    header_surf = _pause_stat_label_font.render("MISSION STATUS", True, C_ORANGE)

    screen.blit(header_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - header_surf.get_width() // 2, _pause_panel_y + 195))

    # Thin divider under the header.
    pygame.draw.line(screen, (90, 50, 20),

                     (WIDTH // 2 - 120, _pause_panel_y + 213),

                     (WIDTH // 2 + 120, _pause_panel_y + 213), 1)

    # ── Status rows ──
    # Compute live values from STATE. Everything degrades gracefully to
    # "—" if the mission hasn't started yet or STATE doesn't have the field.
    try:

        start_t = getattr(STATE, "mission_start_time", 0) or pygame.time.get_ticks()

        elapsed = max(0, (pygame.time.get_ticks() - start_t) // 1000)

        elapsed_str = _format_elapsed(elapsed)

    except Exception:

        elapsed_str = "--:--"

    hostiles = getattr(STATE, "hostiles_killed", 0)

    shots_fired = getattr(STATE, "shots_fired", 0)

    shots_hit = getattr(STATE, "shots_hit", 0)

    accuracy = int((shots_hit / shots_fired) * 100) if shots_fired > 0 else 0

    ammo_in_mag = getattr(STATE, "ammo_in_mag", 0)

    mag_size = getattr(STATE, "mag_size", 0)

    spare_mags = getattr(STATE, "spare_mags", 0)

    # Two columns: labels on the left, values on the right, centered as a block.
    col_label_x = WIDTH // 2 - 140

    col_value_x = WIDTH // 2 + 140

    rows = [

        ("ELAPSED", elapsed_str),

        ("HOSTILES NEUTRALIZED", str(hostiles)),

        ("ACCURACY", f"{accuracy}%  ({shots_hit}/{shots_fired})"),

        ("AMMO", f"{ammo_in_mag}/{mag_size}  +{spare_mags} mags"),

    ]

    row_y = _pause_panel_y + 228

    for label, value in rows:

        lbl_surf = _pause_stat_label_font.render(label, True, C_GREY)

        val_surf = _pause_stat_value_font.render(value, True, C_WHITE)

        screen.blit(lbl_surf, (col_label_x - lbl_surf.get_width(), row_y))

        screen.blit(val_surf, (col_value_x, row_y))

        row_y += 26

    # ── Buttons ──
    for btn in pause_buttons:

        btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

        btn.draw(screen)

_death_animation_start = 0

_death_particles = []

_death_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 70)

_death_sub_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 22, bold=True)

_death_flavor_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 16)

_server_title_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Impact", 46)

def reset_death_animation():

    global _death_animation_start, _death_particles

    _death_animation_start = 0

    _death_particles = []

def draw_death_screen():

    global _death_animation_start, _death_particles

    if _death_animation_start == 0:

        _death_animation_start = pygame.time.get_ticks()

        for _ in range(150):

            _death_particles.append({

                'x': random.randint(0, WIDTH),

                'y': random.randint(0, HEIGHT),

                'r': random.randint(2, 7),

                'a': random.randint(60, 160),

                'vy': random.uniform(0.1, 0.4)

            })

    elapsed = pygame.time.get_ticks() - _death_animation_start

    dark_alpha = min(180, int(elapsed * 0.15))

    overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    overlay.fill((10, 5, 5, dark_alpha))

    screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0))

    beat_cycle = elapsed % 1200

    if beat_cycle < 200:

        beat_intensity = 1.0 - (beat_cycle / 200.0)

    else:

        beat_intensity = 0.0

    vig_alpha = int(100 * beat_intensity) + 30

    vig = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    for i in range(0, WIDTH, 3):

        a = max(0, vig_alpha - int(vig_alpha * i / WIDTH * 1.2))

        if a > 0:

            pygame.draw.rect(vig, (120, 0, 0, a), (i, i, WIDTH - i * 2, HEIGHT - i * 2), 3)

    screen.blit(vig, (0, 0))

    for p in _death_particles:

        p['y'] += p['vy']

        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (80, 5, 5, p['a']), (int(p['x']), int(p['y'])), p['r'])

    if elapsed < 400:

        flash_alpha = max(0, 255 - int(elapsed * 1.2))

        flash = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        if elapsed < 100:

            flash_color = (255, 220, 220, flash_alpha)

        else:

            flash_color = (150, 10, 10, flash_alpha)

        flash.fill(flash_color)

        screen.blit(flash, (0, 0))

    if elapsed > 600:

        text_alpha = min(255, (elapsed - 600) * 2)

        offset_x, offset_y = 0, 0

        if elapsed < 700:

            offset_x = random.randint(-8, 8)

            offset_y = random.randint(-4, 4)

        shadow_surf = _death_font.render("MISSION FAILED", True, (0, 0, 0))

        shadow_surf.set_alpha(text_alpha)

        title_y = HEIGHT // 2 - 140

        screen.blit(shadow_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - shadow_surf.get_width() // 2 + 4 + offset_x, title_y + 4 + offset_y))

        text_surf = _death_font.render("MISSION FAILED", True, (210, 30, 30))

        text_surf.set_alpha(text_alpha)

        screen.blit(text_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - text_surf.get_width() // 2 + offset_x, title_y + offset_y))

    if elapsed > 1000:

        sub_alpha = min(255, (elapsed - 1000) * 2)

        if getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION2":

            sub_text = "OPERATION QUIET ON ROUTE 12 COMPROMISED"

            flavor_text = "VASILE LINK: LOST. IPA CLEANUP TEAMS CLOSING ON ROUTE 12."

        else:

            sub_text = "OPERATION BLACK NOTEBOOK COMPROMISED"

            flavor_text = "KRAP COMMAND: SIGNAL LOST. DISPATCHING CLEANUP CREW."

        sub = _death_sub_font.render(sub_text, True, (180, 180, 180))

        sub.set_alpha(sub_alpha)

        screen.blit(sub, (WIDTH // 2 - sub.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 60))

        flavor = _death_flavor_font.render(flavor_text, True, (120, 120, 120))

        flavor.set_alpha(sub_alpha)

        screen.blit(flavor, (WIDTH // 2 - flavor.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 30))

    if elapsed > 1150:

        panel_alpha = min(230, int((elapsed - 1150) * 0.35))

        try:

            import walking_sim

            civilians_helped = sum(1 for n in walking_sim.walk_npcs if n.get("has_given"))

            rations_used = max(0, 2 - int(walking_sim.player_rations))

        except Exception:

            civilians_helped = 0

            rations_used = 0

        end_t = STATE.mission_end_time or pygame.time.get_ticks()

        start_t = STATE.mission_start_time or end_t

        elapsed_sec = max(0, (end_t - start_t) // 1000)

        accuracy = int((STATE.shots_hit / STATE.shots_fired) * 100) if STATE.shots_fired > 0 else 0

        if getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION2":

            evidence_found = 0

            try:

                evidence_found = sum(1 for item in getattr(STATE, "mission2_evidence", []) if item.get("done"))

            except Exception:

                evidence_found = 0

            stats = [

                ("KILLS", str(STATE.hostiles_killed)),

                ("SHOTS FIRED", str(STATE.shots_fired)),

                ("ACCURACY", f"{accuracy}%"),

                ("TOTAL TIME", f"{elapsed_sec // 60:02d}:{elapsed_sec % 60:02d}"),

                ("EVIDENCE FOUND", f"{evidence_found}/3"),

                ("COMMS", "OFFLINE" if getattr(STATE, "mission2_comms_cut", False) else "VASILE"),

            ]

        else:

            stats = [

                ("KILLS", str(STATE.hostiles_killed)),

                ("SHOTS FIRED", str(STATE.shots_fired)),

                ("ACCURACY", f"{accuracy}%"),

                ("TOTAL TIME", f"{elapsed_sec // 60:02d}:{elapsed_sec % 60:02d}"),

                ("CIVILIANS HELPED", str(civilians_helped)),

                ("RATIONS USED", str(rations_used)),

            ]

        panel_w, panel_h = 520, 104

        panel_x = WIDTH // 2 - panel_w // 2

        panel_y = HEIGHT // 2 + 16

        panel = pygame.Surface((panel_w, panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        panel.fill((8, 8, 12, panel_alpha))

        pygame.draw.rect(panel, (120, 35, 35, min(160, panel_alpha)), panel.get_rect(), 1)

        pygame.draw.rect(panel, (170, 35, 35, min(200, panel_alpha)), (0, 0, 4, panel_h))

        screen.blit(panel, (panel_x, panel_y))

        for i, (label, value) in enumerate(stats):

            col = i % 3

            row = i // 3

            sx = panel_x + 24 + col * 165

            sy = panel_y + 16 + row * 42

            lbl = font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (135, 80, 80))

            val = _death_sub_font.render(value, True, (220, 210, 205))

            lbl.set_alpha(panel_alpha)

            val.set_alpha(panel_alpha)

            screen.blit(lbl, (sx, sy))

            screen.blit(val, (sx, sy + 15))

    if elapsed > 600 and random.random() > 0.92:

        glitch_y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT)

        glitch_h = random.randint(2, 8)

        glitch_surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, glitch_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        glitch_surf.fill((255, 255, 255, 40))

        screen.blit(glitch_surf, (random.randint(-10, 10), glitch_y))

    if elapsed > 1500:

        btn_progress = min(1.0, (elapsed - 1500) / 600.0)

        ease = 1 - (1 - btn_progress) ** 3

        for i, btn in enumerate(death_buttons):

            target_y = HEIGHT // 2 + 150 + i * 60

            start_y = target_y + 40

            current_y = start_y + (target_y - start_y) * ease

            btn.y = int(current_y)

            btn.rect.y = btn.y

            btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

            btn.draw(screen)

# audio.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

import pygame
import math
import random
import struct
import io
import array
import time
import os

SAMPLE_RATE = 22050
MAX_AMP = 32767

def _arr(n):
    return array.array("h", [0]) * n

def _wav(samples):
    n = len(samples)
    data_size = n * 2
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    buf.write(b"RIFF")
    buf.write(struct.pack("<I", 36 + data_size))
    buf.write(b"WAVE")
    buf.write(b"fmt ")
    buf.write(struct.pack("<I", 16))
    buf.write(struct.pack("<H", 1))
    buf.write(struct.pack("<H", 1))
    buf.write(struct.pack("<I", SAMPLE_RATE))
    buf.write(struct.pack("<I", SAMPLE_RATE * 2))
    buf.write(struct.pack("<H", 2))
    buf.write(struct.pack("<H", 16))
    buf.write(b"data")
    buf.write(struct.pack("<I", data_size))
    buf.write(samples.tobytes())
    return buf.getvalue()

def _load(wav_bytes):
    return pygame.mixer.Sound(io.BytesIO(wav_bytes))

def _write(buf, samples, amp=1.0):
    for i in range(len(buf)):
        v = int(samples[i] * amp)
        buf[i] = max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, buf[i] + v))

def _sin(n, freq, amp=1.0, phase=0.0):
    a = _arr(n)
    step = 2 * math.pi * freq / SAMPLE_RATE
    sin = math.sin
    max_amp_amp = MAX_AMP * amp
    for i in range(n):
        a[i] = int(max_amp_amp * sin(phase))
        phase += step
    return a

def _noise(n, amp=1.0):
    a = _arr(n)
    max_amp_amp = MAX_AMP * amp
    for i in range(n):
        a[i] = int(max_amp_amp * (random.random() * 2 - 1))
    return a

def _env_linear(buf, start=1.0, end=0.0):
    n = len(buf)
    for i in range(n):
        t = start + (end - start) * (i / n)
        buf[i] = int(buf[i] * t)

def _env_exp(buf, start=1.0, end=0.001, rate=5.0):
    n = len(buf)
    for i in range(n):
        t = start * math.exp(-rate * i / n)
        if t < end:
            t = 0
        buf[i] = int(buf[i] * t)

def _env_adsr(buf, attack=0.1, decay=0.2, sustain=0.5, release=0.2, sus_level=0.6):
    n = len(buf)
    a_i = int(n * attack)
    d_i = int(n * decay)
    s_i = int(n * (1 - release))
    for i in range(n):
        if i < a_i:
            t = i / a_i
        elif i < a_i + d_i:
            t = 1.0 - (1.0 - sus_level) * ((i - a_i) / d_i)
        elif i < s_i:
            t = sus_level
        else:
            t = sus_level * (1.0 - (i - s_i) / (n - s_i))
        buf[i] = int(buf[i] * t)

def _mix(base, overlay, overlay_amp=1.0):
    for i in range(min(len(base), len(overlay))):
        v = int(overlay[i] * overlay_amp)
        base[i] = max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, base[i] + v))

def _sine_sweep(n, f_start, f_end, amp=1.0):
    a = _arr(n)
    phase = 0.0
    sin = math.sin
    max_amp_amp = MAX_AMP * amp
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / n
        freq = f_start + (f_end - f_start) * t
        a[i] = int(max_amp_amp * sin(phase))
        phase += 2 * math.pi * freq / SAMPLE_RATE
    return a

def _lowpass(buf, strength=0.3):
    prev = 0
    for i in range(len(buf)):
        prev = prev * (1 - strength) + buf[i] * strength
        buf[i] = int(prev)

def _harmonics(n, base_freq, amps, amp=1.0):
    a = _arr(n)
    for i, h_amp in enumerate(amps):
        if h_amp:
            h = _sin(n, base_freq * (i + 1), amp * h_amp)
            _mix(a, h)
    return a

# ── New Powerful DSP Helpers for 16-Bit DOS Style Sound Design ──

def _resonant_filter(buf, cutoff_hz, resonance=0.5, filter_type="low"):
    """
    Chamberlin State Variable Filter (SVF) for beautiful analog-sounding sweeps.
    resonance: damping Q factor from 0.0 (flat) to 0.95 (ringing self-oscillation)
    """
    n = len(buf)
    out = _arr(n)
    cutoff_hz = max(12, min(9500, cutoff_hz))
    
    # SVF coefficients
    f = 2.0 * math.sin(math.pi * cutoff_hz / SAMPLE_RATE)
    q = 2.0 * (1.0 - max(0.0, min(0.95, resonance)))
    
    low = 0.0
    band = 0.0
    
    for i in range(n):
        input_val = float(buf[i])
        high = input_val - low - q * band
        band += f * high
        low += f * band
        
        if filter_type == "low":
            val = low
        elif filter_type == "high":
            val = high
        elif filter_type == "band":
            val = band
        else: # notch
            val = high + low
            
        out[i] = int(max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, val)))
        
    for i in range(n):
        buf[i] = out[i]

def _fm(n, carrier_hz, carrier_amp, mod_hz, mod_index, decay_rate=0.0):
    """
    Two-Operator FM Synthesizer.
    Generates rich metallic, mechanical, brassy, or chest-pounding sounds.
    """
    buf = _arr(n)
    phase_c = 0.0
    phase_m = 0.0
    step_c = 2.0 * math.pi * carrier_hz / SAMPLE_RATE
    step_m = 2.0 * math.pi * mod_hz / SAMPLE_RATE
    
    sin = math.sin
    max_amp_camp = MAX_AMP * carrier_amp
    
    for i in range(n):
        mod_env = math.exp(-decay_rate * i / n) if decay_rate > 0 else 1.0
        current_mod_index = mod_index * mod_env
        
        # Modulator output
        mod_val = sin(phase_m)
        phase_m += step_m
        
        # Frequency modulation
        inst_freq_mod = current_mod_index * step_m * mod_val
        
        buf[i] = int(max_amp_camp * sin(phase_c))
        phase_c += step_c + inst_freq_mod
        
    return buf

def _apply_delay(buf, delay_ms, feedback=0.4, wet=0.3):
    """
    Feedback delay line to simulate space, echo, and acoustic room depth.
    """
    n = len(buf)
    delay_samples = int(SAMPLE_RATE * (delay_ms / 1000.0))
    if delay_samples <= 0 or delay_samples >= n:
        return
    
    history = [0.0] * delay_samples
    ptr = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        dry = float(buf[i])
        delayed = history[ptr]
        
        # Calculate new delay state
        new_history = dry + feedback * delayed
        history[ptr] = max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, new_history))
        ptr = (ptr + 1) % delay_samples
        
        # Mix dry and wet signals
        mixed = dry * (1.0 - wet) + delayed * wet
        buf[i] = int(max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, mixed)))

def _soft_clip(buf, drive=1.0):
    """
    Cubic saturation model to add warmth, weight, and prevent harsh digital clipping.
    """
    for i in range(len(buf)):
        x = (buf[i] / MAX_AMP) * drive
        # Cubic soft clipper
        if x > 1.25:
            y = 1.0
        elif x < -1.25:
            y = -1.0
        else:
            y = x - (x**3) / 3.0
            y = y * 0.95
        buf[i] = int(max(-1.0, min(1.0, y)) * MAX_AMP)

def _offset_mix(base, overlay, offset=0, amp=1.0):
    for i in range(min(len(overlay), len(base) - offset)):
        if offset + i < 0:
            continue
        v = int(overlay[i] * amp)
        base[offset + i] = max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, base[offset + i] + v))

# ── Upgraded DOS/16-Bit Sound Generators ──

def _gen_gunshot_core(volume=1.0, lowpass_strength=0.0):
    """
    Layered gunshot: sharp transient crack → resonant muzzle blast → chest-hitting FM thump → metallic FM casing drop → simulated echo chamber delay.
    """
    dur = 0.85
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Layer 1: Ultra-sharp initial transient (1ms of noise)
    crack_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.001)
    crack = _noise(crack_n, 1.0 * volume)
    _mix(buf, crack)
    
    # Layer 2: Muzzle blast - mid-range noise, resonant lowpass filter
    blast_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.1)
    blast = _noise(blast_n, 0.78 * volume)
    _resonant_filter(blast, 800, 0.35, "low")
    _env_exp(blast, 1.0, 0.001, 24.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, blast, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.001))
    
    # Layer 3: Chest-hitting FM sub thump (Simulates raw kinetic pressure wave)
    thump = _fm(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.35), 55, 0.9 * volume, 110, 1.8, decay_rate=7.0)
    _env_exp(thump, 1.0, 0.001, 6.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, thump, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.003))
    
    # Layer 4: Upper-mid body crackle
    mid_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.15)
    mid = _noise(mid_n, 0.52 * volume)
    _resonant_filter(mid, 2200, 0.2, "low")
    _env_exp(mid, 1.0, 0.001, 15.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, mid, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.002))
    
    # Layer 5: Meaty body resonance (FM carrier 200Hz, modulated by 100Hz)
    body_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.18)
    body = _fm(body_n, 200, 0.36 * volume, 100, 0.8, decay_rate=12.0)
    _env_exp(body, 1.0, 0.001, 14.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, body, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.002))
    
    # Layer 6: Brass shell casing hitting floor (Realistic metallic ring via FM)
    casing_delay = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.4)
    casing_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.15)
    casing = _fm(casing_n, 5200, 0.18 * volume, 8200, 3.5, decay_rate=18.0)
    _env_exp(casing, 1.0, 0.001, 14.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, casing, casing_delay)
    
    # Feedback echo simulating tight indoor warehouse walls
    _apply_delay(buf, 120, feedback=0.35, wet=0.25)
    _apply_delay(buf, 45, feedback=0.2, wet=0.15)
    
    # Cubic saturation and limiting
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.45)
    _env_exp(buf, 1.0, 0.001, 1.4)
    
    if lowpass_strength > 0:
        _resonant_filter(buf, int(750 * (1.0 - lowpass_strength)), 0.1)
        
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_gunshot():
    return _gen_gunshot_core(volume=1.0, lowpass_strength=0.0)

def _gen_gunshot_distant():
    """Muffled distant version: high-frequencies stripped, bass thuds enhanced."""
    return _gen_gunshot_core(volume=0.5, lowpass_strength=0.075)


def _gen_sniper_crack():
    """High-powered distant sniper rifle: supersonic snap + delayed heavy report."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 1.15)
    buf = _arr(n)

    # Instant supersonic crack.
    snap = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.004), 0.98)
    _resonant_filter(snap, 4200, 0.18, "high")
    _env_exp(snap, 1.0, 0.001, 80.0)
    _mix(buf, snap)

    # Rifle report arrives a hair later.
    blast = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.16), 0.62)
    _resonant_filter(blast, 620, 0.38, "low")
    _env_exp(blast, 1.0, 0.001, 16.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, blast, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.035))

    # Distant valley/building slap echo.
    echo = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.34), 0.24)
    _resonant_filter(echo, 280, 0.35, "low")
    _env_exp(echo, 1.0, 0.001, 6.2)
    _offset_mix(buf, echo, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.19))

    # Low pressure bloom.
    sub = _fm(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.55), 45, 0.34, 22, 0.7, decay_rate=4.8)
    _env_exp(sub, 1.0, 0.001, 5.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, sub, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.045))

    _apply_delay(buf, 170, feedback=0.26, wet=0.18)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.45)
    _env_exp(buf, 1.0, 0.001, 1.25)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_bullet_snap():
    """Terrifying near-miss whip/snap passing the listener."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.22)
    buf = _arr(n)
    zip1 = _sine_sweep(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.07), 6200, 1700, 0.42)
    _env_exp(zip1, 1.0, 0.001, 18.0)
    _mix(buf, zip1)
    grit = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.035), 0.34)
    _resonant_filter(grit, 5200, 0.2, "high")
    _env_exp(grit, 1.0, 0.001, 55.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, grit, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.006))
    tail = _sine_sweep(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.12), 1800, 520, 0.16)
    _env_exp(tail, 1.0, 0.001, 13.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, tail, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.035))
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.2)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_concrete_impact():
    """Heavy concrete bullet strike with debris scatter."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.32)
    buf = _arr(n)
    hit = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.028), 0.92)
    _resonant_filter(hit, 760, 0.42, "low")
    _env_exp(hit, 1.0, 0.001, 28.0)
    _mix(buf, hit)
    crunch = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.18), 0.38)
    _resonant_filter(crunch, 420, 0.55)
    _env_exp(crunch, 1.0, 0.001, 9.5)
    _offset_mix(buf, crunch, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.012))
    for off_ms in (38, 74, 112):
        chip = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.018), 0.22)
        _resonant_filter(chip, 2400, 0.25, "high")
        _env_exp(chip, 1.0, 0.001, 36.0)
        _offset_mix(buf, chip, int(SAMPLE_RATE * off_ms / 1000))
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.35)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_tinnitus():
    """Post-near-miss ear ringing with slow fade."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 2.1)
    buf = _arr(n)
    tone = _sin(n, 3180, 0.24)
    wobble = _sin(n, 7.0, 0.06)
    for i in range(n):
        # Amplitude shimmer, intentionally uncomfortable but not too loud.
        amp = 0.72 + 0.28 * math.sin(i * 0.004)
        buf[i] = int(tone[i] * amp + wobble[i] * 0.2)
    _env_adsr(buf, 0.02, 0.18, 0.42, 0.58, 0.72)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.05)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_rifle_handle():
    """Small metallic rifle handling tick for origin reveal tension."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.14)
    buf = _arr(n)
    for off_ms, freq in [(0, 1800), (38, 2600), (82, 1200)]:
        click = _fm(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.025), freq, 0.22, freq * 1.6, 2.4, decay_rate=35.0)
        _env_exp(click, 1.0, 0.001, 42.0)
        _offset_mix(buf, click, int(SAMPLE_RATE * off_ms / 1000))
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.1)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_footstep_variant(pitch_mul=1.0, amp=0.3, dur=0.045):
    """Foley style walk steps: punchy, organic, and clean of boxiness."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Heel strike: FM low-frequency thump (removes paper-thin sound)
    thump = _fm(n, int(82 * pitch_mul), amp, int(41 * pitch_mul), 0.5, decay_rate=20.0)
    _env_exp(thump, 1.0, 0.001, 28.0)
    
    # Friction texture: brief filtered noise
    grit = _noise(n, amp * 0.32)
    _resonant_filter(grit, 450, 0.2)
    _env_exp(grit, 1.0, 0.001, 32.0)
    
    # Toe-off tap transient
    click_n = min(n, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.008))
    click = _noise(click_n, amp * 0.45)
    _resonant_filter(click, 1800, 0.15)
    _env_exp(click, 1.0, 0.001, 60.0)
    
    _mix(buf, thump)
    _mix(buf, grit)
    _offset_mix(buf, click, 0)
    
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.1)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_footstep():
    return _gen_footstep_variant(pitch_mul=1.05, amp=0.34, dur=0.042)

def _gen_melee_hit():
    """Fleshy blunt trauma: solid FM thump + wood/bone shatter + resonant low slap."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.18)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Crack transient
    crack_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.003)
    crack = _noise(crack_n, 0.85)
    _mix(buf, crack)
    
    # Low body punch (FM synthesis carrier 60Hz modulated by 120Hz)
    punch = _fm(n, 60, 0.65, 120, 1.6, decay_rate=14.0)
    _env_exp(punch, 1.0, 0.001, 12.0)
    _mix(buf, punch)
    
    # Bone/flesh resonance harmonics
    thump = _harmonics(n, 160, [0.6, 0.3, 0.1], 0.42)
    _env_exp(thump, 1.0, 0.001, 10.0)
    _mix(buf, thump)
    
    # Ringing knuckles/skull (metallic ping)
    ring_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.06)
    ring = _fm(ring_n, 1200, 0.15, 2400, 2.5, decay_rate=30.0)
    _env_exp(ring, 1.0, 0.001, 25.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, ring, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.005))
    
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.35)
    return _wav(buf)

    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_bullet_impact_enemy():
    """Flesh bullet hit: squishy wet splatter + chest-pounding FM low thump."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.10)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Squishy wet splatter (noise, heavily lowpassed with high resonance Q)
    wet = _noise(n, 0.52)
    _resonant_filter(wet, 180, 0.65, "low")
    _env_exp(wet, 1.0, 0.001, 16.0)
    _mix(buf, wet)
    
    # Low chest thump (FM)
    thump = _fm(n, 58, 0.6, 116, 1.5, decay_rate=12.0)
    _env_exp(thump, 1.0, 0.001, 14.0)
    _mix(buf, thump)
    
    # Upper bone crack
    crack_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.0025)

def _gen_door_creak():
    """Wooden friction creak: slow pitch FM modulator sweep + resonant low groan."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.6)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Swept FM friction squeak
    squeak = _fm(n, 340, 0.28, 48, 1.8)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / n
        pitch_mod = 1.0 + 0.55 * math.sin(t * math.pi * 3.5)
        squeak[i] = int(squeak[i] * pitch_mod)
    _env_adsr(squeak, 0.12, 0.28, 0.45, 0.15, 0.5)
    
    # Wood body groan noise (bandpassed)
    groan = _noise(n, 0.24)
    _resonant_filter(groan, 220, 0.65, "low")
    _env_exp(groan, 1.0, 0.001, 4.0)
    
    _mix(buf, squeak)
    _mix(buf, groan)
    _apply_delay(buf, 40, feedback=0.25, wet=0.2)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.25)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_reload():
    """Tactical reloading: Mag Out (crisp metallic friction) → Mag In (deep mechanical slam) → Slide Release (sliding metal click)."""
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.6)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Mag Out (high metallic scrape, 0.05s)
    m1_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.04)
    mag_out = _fm(m1_n, 1200, 0.58, 1900, 3.5, decay_rate=25.0)
    _env_exp(mag_out, 1.0, 0.001, 35.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, mag_out, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.05))
    
    # Mag In (Heavy chamber latch slam, 0.25s)
    m2_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.05)
    mag_in_fm = _fm(m2_n, 780, 0.65, 1200, 2.8, decay_rate=20.0)
    mag_in_noise = _noise(m2_n, 0.25)
    _resonant_filter(mag_in_noise, 1100, 0.3)
    _mix(mag_in_fm, mag_in_noise)
    _env_exp(mag_in_fm, 1.0, 0.001, 25.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, mag_in_fm, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.25))
    
    # Slide Release (Friction-slide recoil metal, 0.4s)
    s_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.18)
    slide = _fm(s_n, 160, 0.48, 620, 4.2, decay_rate=6.0)
    slide_noise = _noise(s_n, 0.18)
    _resonant_filter(slide_noise, 2800, 0.45)
    _mix(slide, slide_noise)
    _env_adsr(slide, 0.02, 0.05, 0.55, 0.1, 0.65)
    _offset_mix(buf, slide, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.4))
    
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.35)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_ambient_drone():
    """Deep industrial machine hum: Tri-operator FM drone with perfect 5th harmonics + LFO swept resonant lowpass filter."""
    dur = 4.0
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Stacking FM drone operators (sub, mid, fifth)
    drone1 = _fm(n, 55, 0.30, 11, 2.0)
    drone2 = _fm(n, 82.5, 0.18, 16.5, 1.5)  # Perfect fifth
    drone3 = _fm(n, 110, 0.12, 5.5, 1.0)
    _mix(buf, drone1)
    _mix(buf, drone2)
    _mix(buf, drone3)
    
    # Moving resonant lowpass filter on noise bed (Slow sweep over 4 seconds)
    noise = _noise(n, 0.14)
    out_noise = _arr(n)
    low = 0.0
    band = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        # LFO modulating cutoff from 130Hz to 230Hz
        cutoff = 180.0 + 50.0 * math.sin(i * 0.0003)
        f = 2.0 * math.sin(math.pi * cutoff / SAMPLE_RATE)
        high = float(noise[i]) - low - 0.45 * band
        band += f * high
        low += f * band
        out_noise[i] = int(max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, band)))
    _mix(buf, out_noise)
    
    # Soft global loop boundaries fade
    fade = int(n * 0.05)
    for i in range(fade):
        t = i / fade
        buf[i] = int(buf[i] * t)
        buf[n - 1 - i] = int(buf[n - 1 - i] * t)
        
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.1)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_wind():
    """Swirling storm gusts: slow swept resonant filter on wind noise + sub bass rumble."""
    dur = 4.0
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    noise = _noise(n, 0.15)
    # Slow LFO frequency sweep to emulate rushing wind gusts
    low = 0.0
    band = 0.0
    q = 0.32
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE
        cutoff = 380.0 + 160.0 * math.sin(t * 0.8) + 60.0 * math.cos(t * 1.6)
        f = 2.0 * math.sin(math.pi * cutoff / SAMPLE_RATE)
        high = float(noise[i]) - low - q * band
        band += f * high
        low += f * band
        buf[i] = int(max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, low)))
        
    # Deep physical sub roar (modulated volume)
    sub = _sin(n, 42, 0.06)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE
        sub[i] = int(sub[i] * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.sin(t * 0.5)))
    _mix(buf, sub)
    
    fade = int(n * 0.05)
    for i in range(fade):
        t = i / fade
        buf[i] = int(buf[i] * t)
        buf[n - 1 - i] = int(buf[n - 1 - i] * t)
        
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.15)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_explosion():
    """Muffled devastating explosion: thick resonant low-pass roar + deep FM sub thuds + falling concrete crackles + room space echoes."""
    dur = 1.5
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # 1. Main rumble
    noise = _noise(n, 0.82)
    _resonant_filter(noise, 220, 0.4, "low")
    _env_adsr(noise, 0.04, 0.28, 0.5, 0.15, 0.7)
    _mix(buf, noise)
    
    # 2. Huge dual FM chest thumps
    thump = _fm(n, 38, 0.8, 76, 1.8, decay_rate=5.0)
    _env_adsr(thump, 0.02, 0.4, 0.5, 0.05, 0.9)
    _mix(buf, thump)
    
    # 3. High-freq cracking debris
    for _ in range(8):
        off = random.randint(0, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.3))
        ln = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.08)
        crack = _noise(ln, 0.35)
        _resonant_filter(crack, 1500, 0.3)
        _env_exp(crack, 1.0, 0.001, 15.0)
        _offset_mix(buf, crack, off)

    _apply_delay(buf, 180, feedback=0.45, wet=0.35)
    _apply_delay(buf, 75, feedback=0.25, wet=0.2)
    
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.5)
    _env_exp(buf, 1.0, 0.001, 2.5)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_radio_chatter():
    """Garbled vocal transmission: ring modulator + swept bandpass on noise (classic military radio speaker feel)."""
    dur = 2.0
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    noise = _noise(n, 0.22)
    # Garble with Ring Modulation (multiplied by a 400Hz voice pitch)
    for i in range(n):
        mod = 0.35 + 0.65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 380 * i / SAMPLE_RATE))
        buf[i] = int(noise[i] * mod)
        
    # Bandpass voice filter to isolate nasal speaking frequencies
    _resonant_filter(buf, 950, 0.6, "band")
    _env_adsr(buf, 0.08, 0.18, 0.5, 0.2, 0.5)
    
    # Intermittent squelch bursts
    for _ in range(8):
        burst_start = random.randint(0, n - int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.02))
        burst = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.015), 0.32)
        _resonant_filter(burst, 3500, 0.3, "high")
        _env_exp(burst, 1.0, 0.001, 40.0)
        _offset_mix(buf, burst, burst_start)
        
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.35)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_mission_complete():
    """16-bit arpeggiated victory chord: stacked major triads with FM synthesizer brass envelopes."""
    dur = 1.4
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Stacked major triad chord notes (C3, E3, G3, C4)
    freqs = [261.6, 329.6, 392.0, 523.3]
    note_dur = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.8)
    
    for idx, f in enumerate(freqs):
        # Cascaded starting delays (arpeggio style)
        delay = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.12 * idx)
        # FM brass operator (freq modulated by 1.5x ratio)
        tone = _fm(note_dur, f, 0.32, f * 1.5, 1.2, decay_rate=2.2)

        _offset_mix(buf, tone, delay)

    _soft_clip(buf, 1.25)
    return _wav(buf)

    buf = _arr(n)

    _env_adsr(thump, 0.0, 0.18, 0.5, 0.32, 0.7)
    _mix(buf, thump)

    _soft_clip(buf, 1.45)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_molotov_explode():
    """Molotov ignition burst: sharp bottle smash + roaring liquid fire burst."""
    dur = 1.3
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # 1. Glass bottle smash (scattered high-pitch FM ringing)
    for _ in range(6):
        shard_start = random.randint(0, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.04))

        _env_exp(shard, 1.0, 0.001, 35.0)
        _offset_mix(buf, shard, shard_start)

    whoosh_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.8)
    whoosh = _noise(whoosh_n, 0.65)
    low = 0.0
    band = 0.0
    q = 0.45 # high resonance
    for i in range(whoosh_n):
        t = i / whoosh_n
        cutoff = 220.0 + 440.0 * math.sin(t * math.pi)
        f = 2.0 * math.sin(math.pi * cutoff / SAMPLE_RATE)
        high = float(whoosh[i]) - low - q * band
        band += f * high
        low += f * band
        whoosh[i] = int(max(-MAX_AMP, min(MAX_AMP, band)))
        
    _env_adsr(whoosh, 0.02, 0.15, 0.6, 0.25, 0.7)
    _offset_mix(buf, whoosh, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.005))
    
    # 3. Flame crackles (high frequency noise spikes)
    for _ in range(15):
        off = random.randint(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.05), int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.65))
        crackle = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.015), 0.28)

def _gen_terminal_glitch():
    """Digital terminal data transfer: rapid FM data chirps and radio packet breakups."""
    rng = random.Random(301)
    dur = 0.34
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    bed = _noise(n, 0.18)
    _resonant_filter(bed, 650, 0.2, "low")
    _env_exp(bed, 1.0, 0.001, 5.0)
    _mix(buf, bed)
    
    # FM digital burst spikes
    for _ in range(11):
        ln = rng.randint(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.006), int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.026))
        off = rng.randint(0, max(1, n - ln))
        
        # Digital data chirp via FM (1800Hz modulated with high index)
        burst = _fm(ln, rng.uniform(1100, 2600), rng.uniform(0.3, 0.55), 3200, 5.0, decay_rate=25.0)
        _env_exp(burst, 1.0, 0.001, rng.uniform(18.0, 45.0))
        _offset_mix(buf, burst, off)
        
    carrier = _sin(n, 95, 0.055)
    _env_exp(carrier, 1.0, 0.001, 3.5)
    _mix(buf, carrier)
    
    _resonant_filter(buf, 1800, 0.1)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.3)
    _env_linear(buf, 1.0, 0.0)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_missile_launch():
    """Rocket motor launch: heavy dirty ignition cough + low engine pressure roar."""
    rng = random.Random(410)
    dur = 0.78
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Ignition blast
    cough_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.12)
    cough = _noise(cough_n, 0.72)
    _resonant_filter(cough, 180, 0.45, "low")
    _env_exp(cough, 1.0, 0.001, 13.0)
    _mix(buf, cough)
    
    # Engine roar (noise, resonant bandpass)
    roar = _noise(n, 0.3)
    _resonant_filter(roar, 140, 0.5, "low")
    for i in range(n):
        wobble = 0.72 + 0.18 * math.sin(i * 0.006) + 0.10 * math.sin(i * 0.019)
        roar[i] = int(roar[i] * wobble)
    _env_adsr(roar, 0.03, 0.20, 0.45, 0.32, 0.48)
    _mix(buf, roar)
    
    # Sub-bass rocket pressure (FM thud)
    sub = _fm(n, 46, 0.3, 23, 0.5, decay_rate=3.0)
    _env_exp(sub, 1.0, 0.001, 3.0)
    _mix(buf, sub)
    
    _apply_delay(buf, 60, feedback=0.3, wet=0.2)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.4)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_missile_flyby():
    """Rushing air doppler effect: swept-cutoff wind roar past listener."""
    dur = 0.92
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    air = _noise(n, 0.36)
    _resonant_filter(air, 450, 0.1, "low")
    
    for i in range(n):
        x = i / n
        whoosh = math.exp(-((x - 0.42) ** 2) / 0.055)
        flutter = 0.86 + 0.14 * math.sin(i * 0.032)
        air[i] = int(air[i] * (0.18 + 1.05 * whoosh) * flutter)
    _mix(buf, air)
    
    low_air = _noise(n, 0.14)
    _resonant_filter(low_air, 120, 0.1, "low")
    _env_adsr(low_air, 0.14, 0.20, 0.38, 0.28, 0.50)
    _mix(buf, low_air)
    
    _env_adsr(buf, 0.10, 0.18, 0.46, 0.26, 0.60)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.15)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_rig_impact_crack():
    """Distant structural collapse crack: giant filtered crunch."""
    dur = 0.55
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    crack_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.045)
    crack = _noise(crack_n, 0.9)
    _resonant_filter(crack, 380, 0.4, "low")
    _env_exp(crack, 1.0, 0.001, 28.0)
    _mix(buf, crack)
    
    slap = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.20), 0.45)
    _resonant_filter(slap, 180, 0.3)
    _env_exp(slap, 1.0, 0.001, 8.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, slap, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.012))
    
    sub = _fm(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.36), 52, 0.4, 26, 0.5, decay_rate=5.5)
    _env_exp(sub, 1.0, 0.001, 5.5)
    _offset_mix(buf, sub, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.006))
    
    _apply_delay(buf, 140, feedback=0.4, wet=0.3)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.8)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_rig_low_boom():
    """The main dark pressure wave: heavy sub rumble + multi-operator low-end FM."""
    dur = 2.65
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # Overlapping low FM sub layers
    for off_ms, freq, amp, rate in [(0, 36, 0.62, 2.0), (70, 48, 0.48, 2.4), (160, 68, 0.28, 3.1)]:
        ln = n - int(SAMPLE_RATE * off_ms / 1000)
        tone = _fm(max(1, ln), freq, amp, freq // 2, 0.5, decay_rate=rate)
        _offset_mix(buf, tone, int(SAMPLE_RATE * off_ms / 1000))
        
    rumble = _noise(n, 0.36)
    _resonant_filter(rumble, 80, 0.5, "low")
    for i in range(n):
        rumble[i] = int(rumble[i] * (0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(i * 0.0017)))
    _env_exp(rumble, 1.0, 0.001, 1.75)
    _mix(buf, rumble)
    
    _apply_delay(buf, 200, feedback=0.35, wet=0.25)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.35)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_rig_secondary_explosion():
    """Muffled fuel tank eruptions: low thuds and deep rumbles."""
    rng = random.Random(512)
    dur = 1.35
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    for start_ms, amp, lp in [(0, 0.48, 120), (130, 0.34, 100), (310, 0.24, 80)]:
        ln = int(SAMPLE_RATE * rng.uniform(0.24, 0.44))
        blast = _noise(ln, amp)
        _resonant_filter(blast, lp, 0.4, "low")
        _env_exp(blast, 1.0, 0.001, rng.uniform(6.0, 9.0))
        _offset_mix(buf, blast, int(SAMPLE_RATE * start_ms / 1000))
        
    sub = _fm(n, 58, 0.22, 29, 0.5, decay_rate=3.4)
    _env_exp(sub, 1.0, 0.001, 3.4)
    _mix(buf, sub)
    
    _apply_delay(buf, 110, feedback=0.3, wet=0.2)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.4)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_rig_metal_collapse():
    """Collapsing metal beams: grinding FM wood/metal groans + heavy thuds."""
    rng = random.Random(777)
    dur = 2.8
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    for off_ms, start_f, end_f, amp in [(0, 130, 72, 0.2), (260, 96, 54, 0.18), (620, 155, 82, 0.12)]:
        ln = n - int(SAMPLE_RATE * off_ms / 1000)
        groan = _sine_sweep(max(1, ln), start_f, end_f, amp)
        grit = _noise(len(groan), amp * 0.9)
        _resonant_filter(grit, 140, 0.6)
        _mix(groan, grit)
        _env_adsr(groan, 0.08, 0.22, 0.48, 0.22, 0.55)
        _offset_mix(buf, groan, int(SAMPLE_RATE * off_ms / 1000))
        
    # Steel frame snap hits
    for _ in range(15):
        off = rng.randint(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.18), n - int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.12))
        ln = rng.randint(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.07), int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.20))
        hit = _noise(ln, rng.uniform(0.14, 0.32))
        _resonant_filter(hit, rng.randint(80, 240), 0.4)
        _env_exp(hit, 1.0, 0.001, rng.uniform(10, 24))
        _offset_mix(buf, hit, off)
        
    _apply_delay(buf, 150, feedback=0.35, wet=0.25)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.45)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_rig_water_splash():
    """Massive ocean splash: low mass surge + steam spray noise."""
    dur = 1.9
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    slap = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.20), 0.58)
    _resonant_filter(slap, 180, 0.3)
    _env_exp(slap, 1.0, 0.001, 10.5)
    _mix(buf, slap)
    
    surge = _noise(n, 0.24)
    _resonant_filter(surge, 90, 0.1, "low")
    _env_exp(surge, 1.0, 0.001, 2.2)
    _mix(buf, surge)
    
    steam = _noise(n, 0.14)
    _resonant_filter(steam, 1100, 0.2)
    _env_adsr(steam, 0.04, 0.26, 0.44, 0.26, 0.52)
    _offset_mix(buf, steam, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.11))
    
    wave = _sin(n, 39, 0.12)
    _env_exp(wave, 1.0, 0.001, 2.1)
    _mix(buf, wave)
    
    _apply_delay(buf, 120, feedback=0.3, wet=0.2)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.25)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_rig_fire_burst():
    """Fireball whoosh: dark low whoomp + burning roar crackles."""
    dur = 2.35
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    whoomp = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.62), 0.38)
    _resonant_filter(whoomp, 120, 0.4, "low")
    _env_exp(whoomp, 1.0, 0.001, 4.2)
    _mix(buf, whoomp)
    
    burn = _noise(n, 0.13)
    _resonant_filter(burn, 380, 0.1)
    for i in range(n):
        burn[i] = int(burn[i] * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(i * 0.004)))
    _env_adsr(burn, 0.14, 0.24, 0.44, 0.18, 0.45)
    _mix(buf, burn)
    
    sub = _fm(n, 45, 0.1, 22, 0.3, decay_rate=2.6)
    _env_exp(sub, 1.0, 0.001, 2.6)
    _mix(buf, sub)
    
    _apply_delay(buf, 100, feedback=0.25, wet=0.15)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.2)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_type_tick_variant(freq=1350, amp=0.16, dur=0.042):
    """
    Simulates a highly satisfying mechanical typewriter key strike (tactile mechanical click + hollow platen impact + spring ring).
    """
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    
    # 1. High-frequency tactile switch transient (metal key striking paper/platen)
    snap_n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.005)
    snap = _noise(snap_n, amp * 0.85)
    _resonant_filter(snap, 4500, 0.4, "high")
    _env_exp(snap, 1.0, 0.001, 45.0)
    _mix(buf, snap)
    
    # 2. Hollow mechanical body thud (key mechanism hitting platen roller ~280Hz)
    body = _fm(n, freq * 0.2, amp * 0.45, freq * 0.1, 1.5, decay_rate=18.0)
    _resonant_filter(body, 350, 0.5, "low")
    _env_exp(body, 1.0, 0.001, 25.0)
    _mix(buf, body)
    
    # 3. Tiny ringing steel spring ring (gives it authentic typewriter lever resonance)
    spring = _fm(n, freq * 3.5, amp * 0.28, freq * 4.5, 3.2, decay_rate=30.0)
    _env_exp(spring, 1.0, 0.001, 35.0)
    _mix(buf, spring)
    
    # Apply a tight desk-reflection slapback echo
    _apply_delay(buf, 15, feedback=0.15, wet=0.1)
    
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.2)
    return _wav(buf)

def _gen_type_tick():
    return _gen_type_tick_variant(1320, 0.75, 0.040)

def _gen_type_tick_b():
    return _gen_type_tick_variant(1560, 0.70, 0.038)

def _gen_type_tick_c():
    return _gen_type_tick_variant(1180, 0.72, 0.044)

# ── Audio Manager ──

_channels = {}

def _ch(ch_id):
    if ch_id not in _channels:
        idx = min(len(_channels), 31)
        _channels[ch_id] = pygame.mixer.Channel(idx)
    return _channels[ch_id]


# ── Upload OS CRT sounds ──

def _gen_crt_whine():
    """CRT power-on high-voltage whistle (~12 kHz flyback transformer)."""
    dur = 1.2
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    tone = _sin(n, 11800, 0.14)
    for i in range(n):
        wobble = 1.0 + 0.003 * math.sin(i * 0.0008)
        buf[i] = int(tone[i] * wobble)
    harm = _sin(n, 15750, 0.04)
    _mix(buf, harm, 0.6)
    _env_adsr(buf, 0.25, 0.15, 0.35, 0.55, 0.70)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.0)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_crt_thunk():
    """CRT power-off thunk: degauss coil + shadow mask settling."""
    dur = 0.35
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    thump = _fm(n, 110, 0.5, 55, 0.4, decay_rate=18.0)
    _env_exp(thump, 1.0, 0.001, 16.0)
    _mix(buf, thump)
    ring = _sin(n, 420, 0.12)
    _env_exp(ring, 1.0, 0.001, 22.0)
    _mix(buf, ring)
    click = _noise(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.008), 0.3)
    _env_exp(click, 1.0, 0.001, 60.0)
    _mix(buf, click)
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.1)
    return _wav(buf)


def _gen_modem_dialup():
    """Classic 2400 baud modem handshake (dial tone → screech → connect)."""
    rng = random.Random(7703)
    dur = 3.0
    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * dur)
    buf = _arr(n)
    # Dial tone (0.0–0.4s).
    dt_end = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.4)
    dt = _sin(dt_end, 350, 0.12)
    dt2 = _sin(dt_end, 440, 0.10)
    for i in range(dt_end):
        dt[i] = int(dt[i] + dt2[i])
    _offset_mix(buf, dt, 0)
    # DTMF pulse (0.4–0.5s).
    dtmf_len = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.08)
    dtmf = _sin(dtmf_len, 941, 0.18)
    dtmf2 = _sin(dtmf_len, 1336, 0.15)
    for i in range(dtmf_len):
        dtmf[i] = int(dtmf[i] + dtmf2[i])
    _env_exp(dtmf, 1.0, 0.001, 30.0)
    _offset_mix(buf, dtmf, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.4))
    # Ringing (0.5–1.0s).
    ring_dur = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.5)
    rt = _sin(ring_dur, 440, 0.10)
    rt2 = _sin(ring_dur, 480, 0.09)
    for i in range(ring_dur):
        rt[i] = int(rt[i] + rt2[i])
        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE
        if not ((t < 0.15) or (0.25 < t < 0.40)):
            rt[i] = 0
    _offset_mix(buf, rt, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.5))
    # Answering carrier (1.0–1.3s).
    ced = _sin(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.3), 2100, 0.14)
    _env_adsr(ced, 0.05, 0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 0.85)
    _offset_mix(buf, ced, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 1.0))
    # Training screech (1.3–2.5s).
    sc_dur = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 1.2)
    screech = _arr(sc_dur)
    for _ in range(28):
        bl = rng.randint(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.02), int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.08))
        bo = rng.randint(0, max(1, sc_dur - bl))
        freq = rng.uniform(600, 2800)
        burst = _fm(bl, freq, 0.20, freq * rng.uniform(0.5, 2.0),
                    rng.uniform(1.0, 4.0), decay_rate=rng.uniform(8.0, 20.0))
        _env_exp(burst, 1.0, 0.001, rng.uniform(15.0, 35.0))
        _offset_mix(screech, burst, bo)
    bed = _noise(sc_dur, 0.04)
    _resonant_filter(bed, 1500, 0.3, "low")
    _mix(screech, bed)
    _soft_clip(screech, 1.2)
    _offset_mix(buf, screech, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 1.3))
    # Carrier connect (2.5–3.0s).
    carrier = _sin(int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.5), 1650, 0.12)
    _env_adsr(carrier, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.7)
    _offset_mix(buf, carrier, int(SAMPLE_RATE * 2.5))
    _soft_clip(buf, 1.1)
    return _wav(buf)


class AudioManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sounds = {}
        self.master_volume = 0.8
        self.sfx_volume = 1.0       # 0..1 — separate scale for SFX (one-shots + loops)
        self.scheduled = []
        self._loop_channels = {}
        self._loop_base_volumes = {}
        self._duck_frames = 0
        self._duck_factor = 1.0
        self._ambience_names = {"rain", "wind", "ambient_drone"}
        self._init_mixer()
        self._generate_all()
        
    def _pick_footstep(self, prefix, count):
        key = f"{prefix}_{random.randint(1, count)}"
        return self.sounds.get(key, self.sounds.get(prefix))
        
    def _init_mixer(self):
        try:
            if not pygame.mixer.get_init():
                pygame.mixer.init(frequency=SAMPLE_RATE, size=-16, channels=2)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            pygame.mixer.set_num_channels(32)
        except Exception:
            pass
            
    def _generate_all(self):
        gens = [
            ("gunshot", _gen_gunshot),
            ("gunshot_distant", _gen_gunshot_distant),
            ("sniper_crack", _gen_sniper_crack),
            ("bullet_snap", _gen_bullet_snap),
            ("concrete_impact", _gen_concrete_impact),
            ("tinnitus", _gen_tinnitus),
            ("rifle_handle", _gen_rifle_handle),
            ("footstep", _gen_footstep),
            ("footstep_1", _gen_footstep),
            ("footstep_2", _gen_footstep_b),
            ("footstep_3", _gen_footstep_c),
            ("footstep_walk", _gen_footstep_walk),
            ("footstep_walk_1", _gen_footstep_walk),
            ("footstep_walk_2", _gen_footstep_walk_b),
            ("footstep_walk_3", _gen_footstep_walk_c),
            ("melee_hit", _gen_melee_hit),
            ("bullet_impact", _gen_bullet_impact),
            ("bullet_impact_enemy", _gen_bullet_impact_enemy),
            ("door_creak", _gen_door_creak),
            ("door_rattle", _gen_door_rattle),
            ("door_open", _gen_door_open),
            ("reload", _gen_reload),
            ("ambient_drone", _gen_ambient_drone),
            ("rain", _gen_rain),
            ("wind", _gen_wind),
            ("explosion", _gen_explosion),
            ("terminal_glitch", _gen_terminal_glitch),
            ("missile_launch", _gen_missile_launch),
            ("missile_flyby", _gen_missile_flyby),
            ("rig_impact_crack", _gen_rig_impact_crack),
            ("rig_low_boom", _gen_rig_low_boom),
            ("rig_secondary_explosion", _gen_rig_secondary_explosion),
            ("rig_metal_collapse", _gen_rig_metal_collapse),
            ("rig_water_splash", _gen_rig_water_splash),
            ("rig_fire_burst", _gen_rig_fire_burst),
            ("heartbeat", _gen_heartbeat),
            ("menu_click", _gen_menu_click),
            ("menu_hover", _gen_menu_hover),
            ("type_tick", _gen_type_tick),
            ("type_tick_1", _gen_type_tick),
            ("type_tick_2", _gen_type_tick_b),
            ("type_tick_3", _gen_type_tick_c),
            ("radio_static", _gen_radio_static),
            ("radio_chatter", _gen_radio_chatter),
            ("water_drip", _gen_water_drip),
            ("mission_complete", _gen_mission_complete),
            ("breach", _gen_breach),
            ("molotov_throw", _gen_molotov_throw),
            ("molotov_explode", _gen_molotov_explode),
            ("pickup", _gen_pickup),
            ("alarm", _gen_alarm),
            ("empty_click", _gen_empty_click),
            ("glass_shatter", _gen_glass_shatter),
            ("crt_whine", _gen_crt_whine),
            ("crt_thunk", _gen_crt_thunk),
            ("modem_dialup", _gen_modem_dialup),
        ]
        for name, gen in gens:
            try:
                self.sounds[name] = _load(gen())
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Audio gen failed: {name} — {e}")

        # Optional external Mission 3 alarm MP3.
        # Looks for:
        #   assets/alarm.mp3
        # relative to the game folder/current working directory.
        try:
            self._load_optional_sound(
                "mission3_alarm_loop",
                [
                    os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "assets", "alarm.mp3"),
                    os.path.join(os.path.abspath("."), "assets", "alarm.mp3"),
                    os.path.join(os.path.abspath("."), "First try", "assets", "alarm.mp3"),
                    os.path.join(os.path.abspath("."), "Call of Acaristan", "First try", "assets", "alarm.mp3"),
                    r"Call of Acaristan\First try\assets\alarm.mp3",
                ],
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Optional alarm.mp3 load failed: {e}")
                
    def _effective_volume(self, name, volume):
        duck = self._duck_factor if name in self._ambience_names and self._duck_frames > 0 else 1.0
        if name == "wind":
            volume *= 0.40
        elif name == "rain":
            volume *= 0.55
        # SFX scale applies to all sounds EXCEPT streaming music (which is
        # handled separately via pygame.mixer.music.set_volume). This is
        # what makes the Audio → SFX Volume slider actually audible.
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, self.master_volume * self.sfx_volume * volume * duck))

    def play(self, name, volume=1.0, loops=0, channel=None):
        if name in ("footstep", "footstep_walk", "type_tick"):
            variant = f"{name}_{random.randint(1, 3)}"
            s = self.sounds.get(variant, self.sounds.get(name))
            if name == "type_tick":
                volume = min(1.0, volume * 4.5)
        else:
            s = self.sounds.get(name)
        if s is None:
            return None
        vol = self._effective_volume(name, volume)
        s.set_volume(vol)
        if channel is not None:
            c = _ch(channel)
            c.play(s, loops=loops)
        else:
            c = s.play(loops=loops)
        if c and loops != 0:
            self._loop_channels[name] = c
            self._loop_base_volumes[name] = volume
        return c
        
    def play_random(self, prefix, count=3, volume=1.0, loops=0, channel=None):
        return self.play(f"{prefix}_{random.randint(1, count)}", volume=volume, loops=loops, channel=channel)
        
    def schedule(self, delay_frames, name, volume=1.0, loops=0, channel=None):
        self.scheduled.append({
            "delay": max(0, int(delay_frames)),
            "name": name,
            "volume": volume,
            "loops": loops,
            "channel": channel,
        })
        
    def update(self):
        for item in self.scheduled[:]:
            item["delay"] -= 1
            if item["delay"] <= 0:
                self.play(item["name"], item["volume"], item["loops"], item["channel"])
                self.scheduled.remove(item)
        if self._duck_frames > 0:
            self._duck_frames -= 1
            if self._duck_frames <= 0:
                self._duck_factor = 1.0
            for name, ch in list(self._loop_channels.items()):
                if ch is None:
                    continue
                base = self._loop0_base_volumes.get(name, 1.0) if hasattr(self, '_loop0_base_volumes') else self._loop_base_volumes.get(name, 1.0)
                try:
                    ch.set_volume(self._effective_volume(name, base))
                except Exception:
                    pass
                    
    def duck_ambience(self, frames=90, factor=0.35):
        self._duck_frames = max(self._duck_frames, int(frames))
        self._duck_factor = min(self._duck_factor, max(0.0, min(1.0, factor)))
        
    def play_3d(self, name, source_pos, listener_pos, max_dist=800, base_volume=1.0):
        s = self.sounds.get(name)
        if s is None:
            return None
        dx = source_pos[0] - listener_pos[0]
        dy = source_pos[1] - listener_pos[1]
        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if dist >= max_dist:
            return None
        attenuation = max(0.0, 1.0 - (dist / max_dist))
        final_vol = base_volume * self.master_volume * self.sfx_volume * attenuation
        pan = dx / max_dist
        pan = max(-1.0, min(1.0, pan))
        left_vol = final_vol * min(1.0, 1.0 - pan)
        right_vol = final_vol * min(1.0, 1.0 + pan)
        channel = s.play()
        if channel:
            channel.set_volume(left_vol, right_vol)
        return channel
        
    def stop(self, name=None, channel=None):
        if channel is not None and channel in _channels:
            _channels[channel].stop()
        elif name and name in self.sounds:
            self.sounds[name].stop()
            self._loop_channels.pop(name, None)
            self._loop_base_volumes.pop(name, None)
            
    def stop_all(self):
        for ch in _channels.values():
            ch.stop()
        for name in self.sounds:
            try:
                self.sounds[name].stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._loop_channels.clear()
        self._loop_base_volumes.clear()
        self.scheduled.clear()
        
    def set_master_volume(self, vol_0_to_100):
        self.master_volume = max(0.0, min(1.0, vol_0_to_100 / 100.0))
        try:
            pygame.mixer.music.set_volume(self.master_volume * getattr(self, "_current_music_vol", 0.5))
        except Exception:
            pass
        
    def play_music(self, filename, volume=0.5):
        """Loads and streams an MP3 music track in the background."""
        import os
        filepath = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), filename)
        if not os.path.exists(filepath):
            filepath = filename
        if not os.path.exists(filepath):
            print(f"Music file not found: {filename}")
            return False
        try:
            pygame.mixer.music.load(filepath)
            self._current_music_vol = volume
            pygame.mixer.music.set_volume(self.master_volume * volume)
            pygame.mixer.music.play(loops=-1)
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to play music: {e}")
            return False

    def stop_music(self):
        """Stops the streaming background music."""
        try:
            pygame.mixer.music.stop()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def set_music_volume(self, volume):
        """Adjusts the streaming music volume dynamically."""
        self._current_music_vol = volume
        try:
            pygame.mixer.music.set_volume(self.master_volume * volume)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def set_sfx_volume(self, volume):
        """Adjusts the SFX volume scale dynamically.

        Affects all one-shot sound effects + looping ambience. Also refreshes
        any currently-looping sounds so the change is audible immediately
        rather than only on the next play().
        """
        self.sfx_volume = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(volume)))
        for name, ch in list(self._loop_channels.items()):
            if ch is None:
                continue
            base = self._loop_base_volumes.get(name, 1.0)
            try:
                ch.set_volume(self._effective_volume(name, base))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def mute_all(self):
        """Pause every playing sound + streaming music. Used by the
        Audio → Mute on Focus Loss setting when the window loses focus."""
        try:
            pygame.mixer.pause()
            pygame.mixer.music.pause()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def unmute_all(self):
        """Resume everything paused by mute_all()."""
        try:
            pygame.mixer.unpause()
            pygame.mixer.music.unpause()
        except Exception:
            pass
        
    def _load_optional_sound(self, name, candidate_paths):
        """Try to load an external sound file into self.sounds[name].

        Used for user-provided assets like assets/alarm.mp3. If loading fails,
        nothing crashes — gameplay can fall back to the procedural sound.
        """
        for path in candidate_paths:
            try:
                if path and os.path.exists(path):
                    self.sounds[name] = pygame.mixer.Sound(path)
                    print(f"Loaded optional sound '{name}': {path}")
                    return True
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Failed loading optional sound '{name}' from {path}: {e}")
        return False

    def play_mission3_alarm(self, volume=0.22):
        """Start Mission 3 lockdown alarm loop.

        The external alarm.mp3 is likely mastered loud, so this defaults LOW.
        Uses assets/alarm.mp3 if loaded as mission3_alarm_loop.
        Falls back to the procedural alarm if the MP3 is unavailable.
        """
        if "mission3_alarm_loop" in self.sounds:
            return self.play("mission3_alarm_loop", volume=volume, loops=-1, channel="m3_alarm")

        # Fallback procedural alarm, also quieter.
        return self.play("alarm", volume=min(1.0, volume * 0.65), loops=-1, channel="m3_alarm")

    def stop_mission3_alarm(self):
        """Stop Mission 3 lockdown alarm loop."""
        try:
            self.stop("mission3_alarm_loop")
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            self.stop("alarm")
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            self.stop(channel="m3_alarm")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def get_sound(self, name):
        return self.sounds.get(name)
        
    def is_playing(self, channel):
        if channel in _channels:
            return _channels[channel].get_busy()
        return False
        
    def fadeout(self, channel, fade_ms=500):
        if channel in _channels:
            _channels[channel].fadeout(fade_ms)

def _tc(col, row):
    return col * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE // 2, row * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE // 2


def _tile_rect(col, row, w=1, h=1):
    return pygame.Rect(col * TILE_SIZE, row * TILE_SIZE, w * TILE_SIZE, h * TILE_SIZE)


def _zone_world_rect(zone_name):
    tr = ZONE_DEFS[zone_name]["tile_rect"]
    return _tile_rect(tr.x, tr.y, tr.w, tr.h)


ZONE_WORLD_RECTS = {name: _zone_world_rect(name) for name in ZONE_DEFS}


def get_zone_for_world_pos(pos):
    """Return the authored zone name for a world-space point, or None."""
    for name, rect in ZONE_WORLD_RECTS.items():
        if rect.collidepoint(pos):
            return name
    return None

# ── Officers' leisure garden (behind the control building) ──────────────
# The control building's north wall (row 9) is solid — no door on the
# garden side. The garden is a decorated area the player can wander into
# by walking around the NW corner (col 50) or NE corner (col 68) of the
# building. It's an environmental storytelling beat: a manicured officers'
# garden behind a building used for framing MAG creates a contrast that
# makes the IPA feel more human and more monstrous at the same time.
#
# Layout (top-down, N=up, building south wall at row 9):
#   r1:  [tree]  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  [tree]
#   r2:  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers
#   r3:  [hedge NW]              path           [hedge NE]
#   r4:  [hedge NW]  [bench] [fountain] [bench] [hedge NE]
#   r5:  [hedge NW]              path           [hedge NE]
#   r6:  [hedge SW]              path           [hedge SE]
#   r7:  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers
#   r8:  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers  flowers
#         c51      c53      c55-63      c65      c67
#
# The 4 hedges (NW/NE/SW/SE quadrants) have collision — they force the
# player to use the central E-W path. Flowers, benches, and trees are
# walkable (low props). The fountain has collision (it's a solid stone
# basin). Lamp posts have collision (thin poles).
GARDEN_CENTER = _tc(59, 4)        # fountain centerpiece
GARDEN_PATH_NORTH_Y = _tc(0, 3)[1]  # y of path row 3
GARDEN_PATH_SOUTH_Y = _tc(0, 6)[1]  # y of path row 6
# Hedge quadrant rects (world-space pygame.Rects). Each is a 3x2-tile block

# NE hedge: cols 65-67, rows 3-4
# SW hedge: cols 51-53, rows 5-6
# SE hedge: cols 65-67, rows 5-6

# Post-ambush gameplay anchors.  These turn the cutscene's promise (the road is
# a sniper kill-box) into playable objectives: get cover, survive sightlines,
# then flank the gantry.

# Reordered cutscene per the 12-point rework.
#
# - "wrong_scan": squad looks the WRONG way (west cars / south ditch).  This
#   widens the gap between what the audience knows and what the squad knows.
# - "gabi_shot" is now SHORT and has NO laser telegraph for the first kill —
#   she dies mid-sentence to maximize shock.
# - "dead_air" is a held silent beat after Gabi falls (no music, ducked ambience,
#   tinnitus, dripping radio).  The squad is frozen in disbelief.
# - "origin_reveal" now happens AFTER the first death: muzzle flash, brief
#   silhouette of the shooter on the gantry, then he hides again.
# - Seby's death is long and physical (he drags Gabi, shouts at the gantry).
# - Darius's death is mid-radio-call: he reaches for the field radio handset
#   and dies whispering a mayday into it.
# - "biribel_near_miss" freezes player input, slams camera to impact, etc.
# - "handoff": single hard black frame at the very end before gameplay.

def _beat(phase, event, default=0):
    return SNIPER_BEAT_CLOCK.get(phase, {}).get(event, default)

def _beat_now(phase, pt, event):
    f = SNIPER_BEAT_CLOCK.get(phase, {}).get(event)
    return f is not None and pt == f


def _set_tile(g, col, row, tile):
    if 0 <= col < MAP_W and 0 <= row < MAP_H:
        g[row][col] = tile


def _paint_tiles(g, rect, tile):
    for row in range(rect.y, rect.y + rect.h):
        for col in range(rect.x, rect.x + rect.w):
            _set_tile(g, col, row, tile)


def _outline_building(g, col, row, w, h, interior="O", door_tiles=()):
    for yy in range(row, row + h):
        for xx in range(col, col + w):
            border = xx in (col, col + w - 1) or yy in (row, row + h - 1)
            _set_tile(g, xx, yy, "C" if border else interior)
    for dx, dy in door_tiles:
        _set_tile(g, col + dx, row + dy, interior)


def _generate_map():
    g = [["g" for _ in range(MAP_W)] for _ in range(MAP_H)]

    # Paint authored regions first.  Collidable structure is added after.
    for zone in ZONE_DEFS.values():
        _paint_tiles(g, zone["tile_rect"], zone["floor"])

    # Continuous highway spine and shoulders.  These broad open sightlines are
    # intentional: the sniper ambush later weaponizes this road geometry.
    _paint_tiles(g, pygame.Rect(17, 23, 37, 55), ".")
    _paint_tiles(g, pygame.Rect(12, 54, 42, 13), ".")
    _paint_tiles(g, pygame.Rect(7, 70, 25, 8), ".")
    _paint_tiles(g, pygame.Rect(4, 47, 23, 15), "d")
    _paint_tiles(g, pygame.Rect(45, 38, 23, 15), "s")
    _paint_tiles(g, pygame.Rect(39, 12, 28, 16), "O")

    # World border.
    for x in range(MAP_W):
        g[0][x] = g[MAP_H - 1][x] = "C"
    for y in range(MAP_H):
        g[y][0] = g[y][MAP_W - 1] = "C"

    # Control building and offices.
    _outline_building(g, 51, 9, 17, 17, interior="O", door_tiles=((6, 16), (7, 16), (0, 9)))
    # Smaller security hut / checkpoint utility room.
    _outline_building(g, 41, 18, 9, 8, interior="O", door_tiles=((4, 7),))

    # Toll booths and gantry supports.
    for bx, by in [(23, 32), (30, 32), (44, 32), (51, 32), (24, 37), (45, 37)]:
        for yy in range(by, by + 2):
            for xx in range(bx, bx + 2):
                _set_tile(g, xx, yy, "C")
    for sx, sy in [(56, 25), (59, 25), (56, 27), (59, 27)]:
        _set_tile(g, sx, sy, "C")

    # Barriers / cover.  These break up travel without deleting the long sniper
    # sightline through the center lane.
    barriers = [
        (12, 72), (13, 72), (21, 69), (22, 69),
        (18, 61), (19, 61), (27, 60), (28, 60), (37, 58),
        (10, 51), (11, 51), (20, 47), (21, 47),
        (29, 40), (30, 40), (34, 39), (35, 39), (40, 40),
        (47, 45), (48, 45), (62, 47), (63, 47),
        (44, 27), (45, 27), (49, 28), (50, 28),
        (57, 21), (58, 21), (62, 18), (63, 18),
    ]
    for col, row in barriers:
        _set_tile(g, col, row, "B")

    # Final-build density pass: guardrails, broken dividers, service-road clutter,
    # and ditch obstructions.  These are intentionally staggered so the map has
    # shape without blocking the central sniper sightline.
    for row in range(25, 76, 4):
        if row not in (32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39):
            _set_tile(g, 16, row, "B")
            _set_tile(g, 54, row + (row // 4) % 2, "B")
    for row in range(55, 66, 3):
        for col in (14, 41, 46, 51):
            _set_tile(g, col, row, "B")
    for col in range(6, 26, 4):
        _set_tile(g, col, 46, "B")
        _set_tile(g, col + 1, 59, "B")
    for col in range(46, 66, 4):
        _set_tile(g, col, 40, "B")
        _set_tile(g, col + 1, 51, "B")
    for col in range(21, 53, 7):
        _set_tile(g, col, 30, "B")
        _set_tile(g, col + 2, 42, "B")
    # Interior partitions in the control building so it no longer reads as one
    # empty rectangle.  Door gaps keep all evidence reachable.
    for col in range(53, 67):
        if col not in (57, 62):
            _set_tile(g, col, 17, "C")
    for row in range(11, 25):
        if row not in (15, 21):
            _set_tile(g, 60, row, "C")

    # Tanker footprint.  The actual collision uses mission2_tanker_rect.
    for row in range(36, 39):
        for col in range(43, 48):
            _set_tile(g, col, row, "T")

    _set_tile(g, 8, 74, "P")
    _set_tile(g, 64, 12, "X")
    return ["".join(row) for row in g]


MISSION2_MAP = _generate_map()
